Class MutableReachability := mutable_reachability: ctx -> config -> var -> Prop.

Notation "F ⊢ C 'mreach' y" := (mutable_reachability F C y) (at level 40, C at level 59).

| mreach_fld : forall (F : ctx) (t : trm) (fs : stack) (e : renv) (Sigma : heap) Lv
                 (y1 y2 : var) (ds : defs) (a : fld_label),

    inert F ->

    F ⊢ (t; fs; Sigma; e; Lv) mreach y1 ->

    binds y1 (item_obj ds) Sigma -> defs_has ds (def_fld a (avar_f y2)) ->

    F ⁏ e ⊢ trm_var (avar_f y1) ∶ typ_rcd (dec_fld a typ_bot

| mreach_trm : forall (F : ctx) (t : trm) (fs : stack) (e : renv) (Sigma : heap) Lv
                 (y w : var),

    inert F ->

    (tfree w t) \/ (tfree w fs) ->

    binds w y e ->

    F ⁏ e ⊢ trm_var (avar_f w) ∶ (typ_mut_marker typ_bot) ->

    F ⊢ (t; fs; Sigma; e; Lv) mreach y
.

Prove this declaration in `Task.v`:

- `immutability_guarantee`

- `input/Task.v` is the target file; in the proof workspace, it is `Task.v`.
- Any other supplied `.v` files provide support definitions. Use `_CoqProject` for the source list and library mappings.

The project already includes the listed dependencies; do not install anything for the proof run.

## Rules

- Edit only `Task.v` in the submitted solution. You may add helper definitions and lemmas there. Keep all supplied definitions and target names, statements, and hypotheses unchanged. Do not change support files or `_CoqProject`.
- Do not use `Admitted`, `admit`, or `Abort` in the submitted solution. Do not add axioms or new global assumptions (including via `Axiom`, `Parameter`, or `Conjecture`), disable kernel checks (such as guard, positivity, or universe checking), or use equivalent shortcuts.

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra AbstractSyntax.

Require Import Equivalence Indep.

Require Export TypingMode TypingContext.

Notation EnvProperty A B := (forall (e:renv) (v: A) (T: B), Prop).

Notation TypingProperty A B := (forall (G:ctx) (Go: objctx) (e:renv) (v: A) (T: B), Prop).

Class DecTyping (A : Set) := obj_dec_typing: ctx -> objctx -> renv -> A -> dec -> Prop.

Notation "G '§§' Go '⁏' e ⊢ t '∶d' T" := (obj_dec_typing G Go e t T) (at level 40, Go at level 39, e at level 39, t at level 59).

Class Typing (A : Set) := obj_typing: ctx -> objctx -> renv -> A -> typ -> Prop.

Notation "G '§§' Go '⁏' e ⊢ t '∶' T" := (obj_typing G Go e t T) (at level 40, Go at level 39, e at level 39, t at level 59).

Notation typing G e a t := (obj_typing G objctx_empty e a t).

Notation "G '⁏' e ⊢ t '∶' T" := (typing G e t T) (at level 40, e at level 39, t at level 59).

Notation dec_typing G e a d := (obj_dec_typing G objctx_empty e a d).

Notation "G '⁏' e ⊢ t '∶d' T" := (dec_typing G e t T) (at level 40, e at level 39, t at level 59).

Class Subtyping := subtyping: ctx -> objctx -> renv -> typ -> typ -> Prop.

Notation "G '⁏' e '⊢' T '<:' U" := (subtyping G objctx_empty e T U) (at level 40, e at level 39, T at level 59).

Class ReferenceIncapacitate := obj_ref_incap :
                                 ctx -> objctx -> renv -> typ -> typ -> Prop.

Notation "G '§§' Go '⁏' e  ⊢ T1 '∶icp' T2" := (obj_ref_incap G Go e T1 T2)
  (at level 40, Go at level 39, e at level 39, T1 at level 59, T2 at level 59).

Notation ref_incap G e T1 T2 := (obj_ref_incap G objctx_empty e T1 T2).

Notation "G '⁏' e ⊢ T1 '∶icp' T2" :=
  (ref_incap G e T1 T2)
    (at level 40, e at level 39, T1 at level 59, T2 at level 59).

Class CapabilityBound (C : typ_refcap_label) :=
  obj_cap_bnd :
     ctx -> objctx -> renv -> typ -> typ -> Prop.

Notation "G '§§' Go '⁏' e  ⊢ T1 '∶cpb' ⟦ C ⟧  T2" := (@obj_cap_bnd C _ G Go e T1 T2)
  (at level 40, Go at level 39, e at level 39, T1 at level 59, T2 at level 59).

Notation cap_bnd C G e T1 T2 := (@obj_cap_bnd C _ G objctx_empty e T1 T2).

Notation "G '⁏' e ⊢ T1 '∶cpb' ⟦ C ⟧ T2" := (cap_bnd C G e T1 T2)
    (at level 40, e at level 39, T1 at level 59, T2 at level 59).

Notation typ_cap_adapt C x Tcap := (
  typ_cap_marker C (typ_or Tcap
    (typ_sel (avar_f x) (typ_label_refcap C) (avar_b 0))
  )).

Section WithTypingMode.

Context (typing_mode: Mode).

Inductive ty_var : Typing var :=

| ty_var_var : forall G e x T,
    ctx_binds x T G ->
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ T

| ty_rec_intro : forall G e x T,
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ open x T ->
    typ_indep_b 0 T ->

    ((mode_has_incap typing_mode) -> (G⁏e ⊢ (open x T) ∶icp (open x T))) ->
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ typ_bnd T

| ty_rec_elim : forall G e x T,
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ typ_bnd T ->
    typ_indep_b 0 T ->
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ open x T

| ty_var_and : forall G e x T U,
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ T ->
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ U ->
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ typ_and T U

| ty_var_sub : forall G e x T U,
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ T ->
    G⁏e ⊢ T <: U ->
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ U

| ty_var_mut_top : forall G e x T,
    mode_has_mutability typing_mode ->
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ T ->
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ (typ_mut_marker typ_top)

with subtyp : Subtyping :=

| subtyp_top: forall G e T,
    G⁏e ⊢ T <: typ_top

| subtyp_bot: forall G e T,
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_bot <: T

| subtyp_refl: forall G e T,
    G⁏e ⊢ T <: T

| subtyp_trans: forall G e S T U,
    G⁏e ⊢ S <: T ->
    G⁏e ⊢ T <: U ->
    G⁏e ⊢ S <: U

| subtyp_and11: forall G e T U,
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_and T U <: T

| subtyp_and12: forall G e T U,
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_and T U <: U

| subtyp_and2: forall G e S T U,
    G⁏e ⊢ S <: T ->
    G⁏e ⊢ S <: U ->
    G⁏e ⊢ S <: typ_and T U

| subtyp_or11: forall G e T U,
    G⁏e ⊢ T <: typ_or T U

| subtyp_or12: forall G e T U,
    G⁏e ⊢ U <: typ_or T U

| subtyp_or2: forall G e S T U,
    G⁏e ⊢ S <: T ->
    G⁏e ⊢ U <: T ->
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_or S U <: T

| subtyp_fld: forall G e a T1 T2 U1 U2,
    G⁏e ⊢ T1 <: T2 ->
    G⁏e ⊢ U1 <: U2 ->
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_rcd (dec_fld a T2 U1) <: typ_rcd (dec_fld a T1 U2)

| subtyp_typ: forall G e A S1 T1 S2 T2,
    (forall x, G⁏e ⊢ (open x S2) <: (open x S1)) ->
    (forall x, G⁏e ⊢ (open x T1) <: (open x T2)) ->
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_rcd (dec_typ A S1 T1) <: typ_rcd (dec_typ A S2 T2)

| subtyp_sel2: forall G e x A y S T,
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ typ_rcd (dec_typ A S T) ->
    G⁏e ⊢ (open y S) <: typ_sel (avar_f x) A (avar_f y)

| subtyp_sel1: forall G e x A y S T,
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ typ_rcd (dec_typ A S T) ->
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_sel (avar_f x) A (avar_f y) <: (open y T)

| subtyp_fun: forall L G e S1 T1 S2 T2,
    mode_has_fun typing_mode ->
    G⁏e ⊢ S2 <: S1 ->
    (forall x, x \notin L ->
       G § x / v_par ~ S2 ⁏e ⊢ open x T1 <: open x T2) ->
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_fun S1 T1 <: typ_fun S2 T2

| subtyp_met: forall L G e m TC1 TZ1 TR1 TC2 TZ2 TR2,
    G⁏e ⊢ TZ2 <: TZ1 ->
    (forall x, x \notin L ->
    G § x / v_par ~ TZ2 ⁏e ⊢ open x TC2 <: open x TC1) ->

    (mode_has_sef typing_mode -> typ_indep_b 0 TC2 -> typ_indep_b 0 TC1) ->
    (forall x, x \notin L ->
     forall y, y <> x -> y \notin L ->
    (ctx_met G x TZ2 y TC2) ⁏e ⊢ open_met x y TR1 <: open_met x y TR2) ->
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_rcd (dec_met m TC1 TZ1 TR1) <: typ_rcd (dec_met m TC2 TZ2 TR2)

| subtyp_tyq: forall G e T1 T2,
    e ⊢ T1 ≈ T2 ->
    G⁏e ⊢ T1 <: T2

| subtyp_typ_and: forall G e A S1 T1 S2 T2,
    G⁏e ⊢
     typ_and
       (typ_rcd (dec_typ A S1 T1))
       (typ_rcd (dec_typ A S2 T2))
     <: typ_rcd (dec_typ A (typ_or S1 S2) (typ_and T1 T2))

| subtyp_dist: forall G e T1 T2 T3,
    G⁏e ⊢
      typ_and T1 (typ_or T2 T3)
      <: typ_or (typ_and T1 T2) (typ_and T1 T3)

| subtyp_nocap_bnd G e T:
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_nocap <: typ_bnd T

| subtyp_nocap_typ G e A T1 T2:
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_nocap <: typ_rcd (dec_typ (typ_label_normal A) T1 T2)

| subtyp_nocap_fld G e a T1 T2:
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_nocap <: typ_rcd (dec_fld a T1 T2)

| subtyp_nocap_met G e a TC TZ TR:
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_nocap <: typ_rcd (dec_met a TC TZ TR)

| subtyp_nocap_fun G e TZ TR:
    mode_has_fun typing_mode ->
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_nocap <: typ_fun TZ TR

| subtyp_nocap_mut_top_boundless G e T1 T2:
    mode_has_top_nm_subtype_boundless typing_mode ->
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_top <: (typ_or typ_nocap (typ_rcd (dec_typ (typ_label_refcap typ_refcap_mutability) T1 T2)))

| subtyp_nocap_mut_top_complement G e:
    mode_has_top_nm_complement typing_mode ->
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_top <: (typ_or typ_nocap (typ_mut_marker typ_bot) )

| subtyp_nocap_mut_bot G e:
    mode_has_top_nm_complement typing_mode ->
    G⁏e ⊢ (typ_and typ_nocap (typ_mut_marker typ_bot)) <: typ_bot

| subtyp_mut_top G e:
    mode_has_mut_top typing_mode ->
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_top <: (typ_mut_marker typ_top)

with ty_incap : ReferenceIncapacitate :=

| ty_incap_top G e:
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_top ∶icp typ_top

| ty_incap_bot G e:
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_bot ∶icp typ_nocap

| ty_incap_typ G e A S T:
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_rcd (dec_typ (typ_label_normal A) S T)
     ∶icp typ_rcd (dec_typ (typ_label_normal A) S T)

| ty_incap_cap G e M S T:
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_rcd (dec_typ (typ_label_refcap M) S T)
     ∶icp typ_top

| ty_incap_met G e m TC TZ TR:
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_rcd (dec_met m TC TZ TR) ∶icp typ_rcd (dec_met m TC TZ TR)

| ty_incap_fld G e a T1 T2:
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_rcd (dec_fld a T1 T2) ∶icp typ_rcd (dec_fld a T1 T2)

| ty_incap_sel G e x B y S T T':
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ typ_rcd (dec_typ B S T) ->
    G⁏e ⊢ (open y T) ∶icp T' ->
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_sel (avar_f x) B (avar_f y) ∶icp T'

| ty_incap_rec G e T:
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_bnd T ∶icp typ_bnd T

| ty_incap_and G e S1 T1 S2 T2:
    G⁏e ⊢ S1 ∶icp S2 ->
    G⁏e ⊢ T1 ∶icp T2 ->
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_and S1 T1 ∶icp typ_and S2 T2

| ty_incap_or G e S1 T1 S2 T2:
    G⁏e ⊢ S1 ∶icp S2 ->
    G⁏e ⊢ T1 ∶icp T2 ->
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_or S1 T1 ∶icp typ_or S2 T2

| ty_incap_fun G e S T:
    mode_has_fun typing_mode ->
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_fun S T ∶icp typ_fun S T

| ty_incap_nocap G e T:
    mode_incap' typing_mode = mode_incap_nocap ->
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_nocap <: T ->
    G⁏e ⊢ T ∶icp T
.

Global Existing Instance ty_var.

Global Existing Instance subtyp.

Global Existing Instance ty_incap.

Inductive ty_capbnd (C : typ_refcap_label) : CapabilityBound C :=
| ty_capbnd_top G e:
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_top ∶cpb⟦C⟧ typ_top

| ty_capbnd_bot G e:
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_bot ∶cpb⟦C⟧ typ_bot

| ty_capbnd_typ G e A S T:

  and11 G e T U: ST G e (typ_and T U) T;
  and12 G e T U: ST G e (typ_and T U) U;
  and2 G e S T U:

  or11 G e T U: ST G e T (typ_or T U);

  or2 G e S T U:
    ST G e S T ->
    ST G e U T ->
    ST G e (typ_or S U) T;
  trans G e S T U:
    ST G e S T ->
    ST G e T U ->
    ST G e S U;
}.

Definition ctx_obj_met typing_mode (G: ctx)(Go: objctx)(xz: var)(TZ: typ)(xc: var)(TC: typ) :=
  match Go with
  | objctx_empty => ctx_met (vis_hide typing_mode G) xz TZ xc TC
  | objctx_lit x T => ctx_met_refined (vis_hide typing_mode (G § x / v_self ~ open x T)) xz TZ xc TC (typ_and (open x T) (open xc T))

Inductive ctx: Set :=

| ctx_empty

| ctx_push: ctx -> var -> varkind -> typ -> ctx

| ctx_stop: ctx -> ctx

| ctx_hide: ctx -> ctx
.

Notation "G '§' v / vk ~ T" := (ctx_push G v vk T)
  (at level 30, vk at level 20, v at level 20, T at level 20).

Notation "v / vk ~ T" := (ctx_push ctx_empty v vk T)
  (at level 30, vk at level 20, T at level 20).

Notation "G '§ʸ' v ~ T" := (ctx_push G v v_loc T)
  (at level 30, v at level 20, T at level 20).

Notation "G '§ʷ' v ~ T" := (ctx_push G v v_ref T)
  (at level 30, v at level 20, T at level 20).

Notation "G '§ʳ' v ~ T" := (ctx_push G v v_recv T)
  (at level 30, v at level 20, T at level 20).

Notation "G '§ᶻ' v ~ T" := (ctx_push G v v_par T)
  (at level 30, v at level 20, T at level 20).

Notation "G '§ˢ' v ~ T" := (ctx_push G v v_self T)
  (at level 30, v at level 20, T at level 20).

Notation "G '§ˣ' v ~ T" := (ctx_push G v v_let T)
  (at level 30, v at level 20, T at level 20).

Fixpoint ctx_concat(G1 G2: ctx): ctx :=
match G2 with
| ctx_empty => G1
| ctx_push c v vk t => ctx_push (ctx_concat G1 c) v vk t
| ctx_stop c => ctx_stop (ctx_concat G1 c)
| ctx_hide c => ctx_hide (ctx_concat G1 c)
end.

Notation "E §& F" := (ctx_concat E F)
  (at level 28, left associativity) : env_scope.

Fixpoint ctx_map(fn: typ -> typ)(G: ctx): ctx :=
match G with
| ctx_empty => ctx_empty
| ctx_push G1 v vk t => ctx_push (ctx_map fn G1) v vk (fn t)
| ctx_stop G1 => ctx_stop (ctx_map fn G1)
| ctx_hide G1 => ctx_hide (ctx_map fn G1)
end.

Fixpoint ctx_collect_values(A: Set)(fn: typ -> fset A)(G: ctx): fset A :=
match G with
| ctx_empty => \{}
| ctx_push G1 v vk t => (fn t) \u (ctx_collect_values fn G1)
| ctx_stop G1 => (ctx_collect_values fn G1)
| ctx_hide G1 => (ctx_collect_values fn G1)
end.

Notation ctx_fv := (ctx_collect_values fv).

Instance CtxFreeVar : FreeVar ctx := ctx_fv.

Fixpoint ctx_keys(G: ctx): list var :=
match G with
| ctx_empty => nil
| ctx_push G v vk t =>  v :: (ctx_keys G)
| ctx_stop G => ctx_keys G
| ctx_hide G => ctx_keys G
end.

Fixpoint ctx_dom(G: ctx): fset var :=
match G with
| ctx_empty => \{}
| ctx_push G v vk t =>  \{ v } \u (ctx_dom G)
| ctx_stop G => ctx_dom G
| ctx_hide G => ctx_dom G
end.

Notation "x '§#' E" := (x \notin (ctx_dom E)) (at level 67) : env_scope.

Inductive ctx_ok: ctx -> Prop :=
| ctx_ok_empty:
  ctx_ok ctx_empty
| ctx_ok_push(G: ctx)(v: var)(vk: varkind)(t: typ):
  ctx_ok G ->
  v §# G ->
  ctx_ok (ctx_push G v vk t)
| ctx_ok_stop(G: ctx):
  ctx_ok G -> ctx_ok (ctx_stop G)
| ctx_ok_hide(G: ctx):
  ctx_ok G -> ctx_ok (ctx_hide G)
.

Inductive ctx_weakens: ctx -> Prop :=
| ctx_weakens_empty: ctx_weakens ctx_empty
| ctx_weakens_push G v vk t:
  ctx_weakens G ->
  ctx_weakens (ctx_push G v vk t)
.

Inductive ctx_weakens_hide: ctx -> Prop :=
| ctx_weakens_hide_empty: ctx_weakens_hide ctx_empty
| ctx_weakens_hide_push G v vk t:
    ctx_weakens_hide G ->
    ctx_weakens_hide (ctx_push G v vk t)
| ctx_weakens_hide_hide G:
    ctx_weakens_hide G ->
    ctx_weakens_hide (ctx_hide G)
.

Inductive ctx_binds: var -> typ -> ctx -> Prop :=
| ctx_binds_e(v: var)(vk: varkind)(t: typ)(G: ctx):
    ctx_binds v t (ctx_push G v vk t)
| ctx_binds_n(v v2: var)(vk: varkind)(t t2: typ)(G: ctx):
    v <> v2 ->
    ctx_binds v t G ->
    ctx_binds v t (ctx_push G v2 vk t2)
| ctx_binds_hide(v: var)(t: typ)(G: ctx):
    ctx_binds v t G ->
    ctx_binds v t (ctx_hide G)
.

Inductive ctx_binds_k_after: var -> varkind -> typ -> ctx -> ctx -> Prop :=
| ctx_binds_k_e(v: var)(vk: varkind)(t: typ)(G: ctx):
    ctx_binds_k_after v vk t (ctx_push G v vk t) G
| ctx_binds_k_n(v v2: var)(vk1 vk2: varkind)(t t2: typ)(G1 G2: ctx):
    v <> v2 ->
    ctx_binds_k_after v vk1 t G1 G2 ->
    ctx_binds_k_after v vk1 t (ctx_push G1 v2 vk2 t2) G2
.

Fixpoint ctx_kdom(vk: varkind)(c: ctx): fset var :=
match c with
| ctx_empty => \{}
| ctx_push c v vk2 t => If (vk = vk2) then (\{ v } \u (ctx_kdom vk c)) else (ctx_kdom vk c)
| ctx_stop c => ctx_kdom vk c
| ctx_hide c => ctx_kdom vk c
end.

Definition ctx_k G v vk:=
  exists t G2, ctx_binds_k_after v vk t G G2.

Notation subst_ctx x y := (ctx_map (subst_var x y)).

Notation "G '/[§' x '->' y ']'" :=
  (subst_ctx x y G) (x at level 69, at level 7, left associativity) : syntax_scope.

Notation subst_ctx_vars xs ys := (ctx_map (subst_vars xs ys)).

Notation "G '/[§' xs '-->' ys ']'" :=
  (subst_ctx_vars xs ys G) (xs at level 69, at level 7, left associativity) : syntax_scope.

Notation subst_ctx_pvars xs ys := (ctx_map (subst_pvars xs ys)).

Notation "G '//[§' xs '-->' ys ']'" :=
  (subst_ctx_pvars xs ys G) (xs at level 69, at level 7, left associativity) : syntax_scope.

Fixpoint ctx_seal_rec n x G :=
  match G with
  | ctx_empty => ctx_empty
  | ctx_stop G => ctx_stop (ctx_seal_rec n x G)
  | ctx_hide G => ctx_hide (ctx_seal_rec n x G)
  | ctx_push G y vk t => ctx_push (ctx_seal_rec n x G) y vk (seal_rec n x t)
  end.

Instance CtxSealable: Sealable ctx := ctx_seal_rec.

Inductive ctx_vis: ctx -> var -> Prop :=
| ctx_vis_e(v: var)(vk: varkind)(t: typ)(G: ctx):
    ctx_vis (ctx_push G v vk t) v
| ctx_vis_n(v v2: var)(vk: varkind)(t: typ)(G: ctx):
    v <> v2 ->
    ctx_vis G v ->
    ctx_vis (ctx_push G v2 vk t) v
.

Inductive objctx: Set :=

| objctx_empty: objctx
| objctx_lit(x: var)(T: typ): objctx
| objctx_heap(y: var)(T: typ): objctx
.

Notation ctx_met G xz TZ xc TC := (G § xz / v_par ~ TZ § xc / v_recv ~ (open xz TC)).

Notation open_met xz xc T := (open xz (open_rec 1 xc T)) (only parsing).

Notation close_met z r T := (close z (close_rec 1 r T)) (only parsing).

Definition ctx_obj(G: ctx)(Go: objctx) :=
  match Go with
  | objctx_empty => G
  | objctx_lit x T => G § x / v_self ~ open x T
  | objctx_heap y T => G
  end.

Notation ctx_met_refined G xz TZ xc TC TC2 := (G § xz / v_par ~ TZ § xc / v_recv ~ (typ_and (open xz TC) TC2)).

Notation ctx_met_refined_heap G xz TZ xc TC y T := (ctx_met_refined G xz TZ xc TC (typ_and (open y T) (open xc T))).

Definition subst_objctx vSrc vDst Go :=
  match Go with
  | objctx_empty => objctx_empty
  | objctx_lit x T => objctx_lit x (subst_var vSrc vDst T)
  | objctx_heap y T => objctx_heap (subst_var vSrc vDst y) (subst_var vSrc vDst T)
  end.

Notation "G '/[§§' x '->' y ']'" :=
  (subst_objctx x y G) (x at level 69, at level 7, left associativity) : syntax_scope.

Definition subst_objctx_pvars xs ys Go :=
  match Go with
  | objctx_empty => objctx_empty
  | objctx_lit x T => objctx_lit x (subst_pvars xs ys T)
  | objctx_heap y T => objctx_heap (subst_pvars xs ys y) (subst_pvars xs ys T)
  end.

Definition subst_objctx_varx vsSrc vsDst Go :=
  match Go with
  | objctx_empty => objctx_empty
  | objctx_lit x T => objctx_lit x (subst_vars vsSrc vsDst T)
  | objctx_heap y T => objctx_heap (subst_vars vsSrc vsDst y) (subst_vars vsSrc vsDst T)
  end.

Definition objctx_dom Go :=
  match Go with
  | objctx_empty => \{}
  | objctx_lit x T => \{ x }
  | objctx_heap y T => \{}
  end.

Definition objctx_keys Go: list var :=
  match Go with
  | objctx_empty => nil
  | objctx_lit x T => x::nil
  | objctx_heap y T => nil
  end.

Definition objctx_fv Go :=
  match Go with
  | objctx_empty => \{}
  | objctx_lit x T => fv T
  | objctx_heap y T => \{y} \u (fv T)
  end.

Notation "G '§§&' Go" := (ctx_obj G Go)  (at level 28, left associativity).

Fixpoint objctx_seal_rec n y G {struct G} :=
  match G with
  | objctx_empty => objctx_empty
  | objctx_heap x T => objctx_heap x (seal_rec (S n) y T)
  | objctx_lit x T => objctx_lit x (seal_rec (S n) y T)
  end.

Instance ObjctxSealable: Sealable objctx := objctx_seal_rec.

Class TFree(A : Set) := tfree: var -> A -> Prop.

Inductive tfree_trm: TFree trm :=

| tfree_trm_var v:
  tfree_trm v (trm_var (avar_f v))

| tfree_trm_read v1 l:
  tfree_trm v1 (trm_read (avar_f v1) l)

| tfree_trm_apply_l v1 a2:
  tfree_trm v1 (trm_apply (avar_f v1) a2)
| tfree_trm_apply_r a1 v2:
  tfree_trm v2 (trm_apply a1 (avar_f v2))

| tfree_trm_let_l v t1 t2:
  tfree_trm v t1 ->
  tfree_trm v (trm_let t1 t2)
| tfree_trm_let_r v t1 t2:
  tfree_trm v t2 ->
  tfree_trm v (trm_let t1 t2)

| tfree_trm_lit_l v t1 t2:
  tfree_lit v t1 ->
  tfree_trm v (trm_lit t1 t2)
| tfree_trm_lit_r v t1 t2:
  tfree_trm v t2 ->
  tfree_trm v (trm_lit t1 t2)

| tfree_trm_write_l v1 a2 l:
  tfree_trm v1 (trm_write (avar_f v1) l a2)
| tfree_trm_write_r a1 v2 l:
  tfree_trm v2 (trm_write a1 l (avar_f v2))

| tfree_trm_call_l v1 a2 l:
  tfree_trm v1 (trm_call (avar_f v1) l a2)
| tfree_trm_call_r a1 v2 l:
  tfree_trm v2 (trm_call a1 l (avar_f v2))

with tfree_lit: TFree lit :=

| tfree_lit_fun v t T:
  tfree_trm v t ->
  tfree_lit v (lit_fun T t)
| tfree_lit_obj v t T:
  tfree_defs v t ->
  tfree_lit v (lit_obj T t)

with tfree_def: TFree def :=

| tfree_def_trm v l:
  tfree_def v (def_fld l (avar_f v))

| tfree_def_met v t l:
  tfree_trm v t ->
  tfree_def v (def_met l t)

with tfree_defs: TFree defs :=

| tfree_defs_cons_l v d ds:
  tfree_defs v ds ->
  tfree_defs v (defs_cons ds d)
| tfree_defs_cons_r v d ds:
  tfree_def v d ->
  tfree_defs v (defs_cons ds d)
.

Scheme tfree_trm_mut    := Induction for tfree_trm Sort Prop
with   tfree_lit_mut    := Induction for tfree_lit Sort Prop
with   tfree_def_mut    := Induction for tfree_def Sort Prop
with   tfree_defs_mut   := Induction for tfree_defs Sort Prop.

Combined Scheme tfree_mutind from tfree_trm_mut, tfree_lit_mut,
tfree_def_mut, tfree_defs_mut.

Inductive tfree_stack: TFree stack :=

| tfree_stack_cons_l v t st:
  tfree_trm v t ->
  tfree_stack v (stack_cons (frame_let t) st)
| tfree_stack_cons_r v f st:
  tfree_stack v st ->
  tfree_stack v (stack_cons f st)
.

Existing Instance tfree_trm.

Existing Instance tfree_lit.

Existing Instance tfree_def.

Existing Instance tfree_defs.

Existing Instance tfree_stack.

Definition all_tfree_k {A: Set} {AT: TFree A} G (t:A) vk :=
  forall v, tfree v t -> ctx_k G v vk.

Notation all_tfree_k_trm := (@all_tfree_k trm _).

Inductive record_dec : dec -> Prop :=
| rd_typ : forall A T, record_dec (dec_typ (typ_label_normal A) T T)
| rd_typb : forall A T, record_dec (dec_typ (typ_label_normal A) typ_bot T)
| rd_fld : forall a T, record_dec (dec_fld a T T)
| rd_met : forall m TC TZ TR, record_dec (dec_met m TC TZ TR)
.

Inductive record_typ : typ -> fset label -> Prop :=
| rt_one : forall D l,
  record_dec D ->
  l = label_of D ->
  record_typ (typ_rcd D) \{l}
| rt_cons: forall T ls D l,
  record_typ T ls ->
  record_dec D ->
  l = label_of D ->
  l \notin ls ->
  record_typ (typ_and T (typ_rcd D)) (union ls \{l}).

Definition record_type T := exists ls, record_typ T ls.

Inductive refcap_dec: dec -> Prop :=
  | refcap_dec_typb lt TU:
    refcap_dec (dec_typ (typ_label_refcap lt) typ_bot TU).

Inductive refcap_typ: typ -> fset label -> Prop :=
  | refcap_typ_top:
      refcap_typ typ_top \{}
  | refcap_typ_one D l:
      refcap_dec D ->
      l = label_of D ->
      refcap_typ (typ_rcd D) \{l}
  | refcap_typ_cons T ls D l:
      refcap_typ T ls ->
      refcap_dec D ->
      l = label_of D ->
      l \notin ls ->
      refcap_typ (typ_and T (typ_rcd D)) (union ls \{l}).

Definition refcap_type T := exists ls, refcap_typ T ls.

Inductive record_has: typ -> dec -> Prop :=
| rh_one : forall D,
    record_has (typ_rcd D) D
| rh_andl : forall T U D,
    record_has T D ->
    record_has (typ_and T U) D
| rh_andr : forall T U D,
    record_has U D ->
    record_has (typ_and T U) D.

Inductive typ : Set :=

  | typ_bot  : typ
  | typ_rcd  : dec -> typ
  | typ_and  : typ -> typ -> typ
  | typ_or   : typ -> typ -> typ
  | typ_sel  : avar -> typ_label -> avar -> typ
  | typ_bnd  : typ -> typ
  | typ_fun  : typ -> typ -> typ
  | typ_nocap: typ

with dec : Set :=
  | dec_typ: typ_label -> typ -> typ -> dec
  | dec_fld: fld_label -> typ -> typ -> dec
  | dec_met: met_label ->  typ -> typ -> typ -> dec
.

Notation typ_cap_marker C T := (typ_rcd (dec_typ (typ_label_refcap C) typ_bot T)) (only parsing).

Notation typ_mut_marker T := (typ_cap_marker typ_refcap_mutability T) (only parsing).

Scheme typ_mut  := Induction for typ Sort Prop
with   dec_mut  := Induction for dec Sort Prop.

Combined Scheme typ_mutind from typ_mut, dec_mut.

Fixpoint open_rec_typ (k: nat) (u: var) (T: typ) {struct T} : typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_top        => typ_top
  | typ_bot        => typ_bot
  | typ_rcd D      => typ_rcd (open_rec_dec k u D)
  | typ_and T1 T2  => typ_and (open_rec_typ k u T1)
                             (open_rec_typ k u T2)
  | typ_or T1 T2  => typ_or (open_rec_typ k u T1)
                             (open_rec_typ k u T2)
  | typ_sel x L y => typ_sel (open_rec k u x) L (open_rec k u y)
  | typ_bnd T      => typ_bnd (open_rec_typ (S k) u T)
  | typ_fun T1 T2  => typ_fun (open_rec_typ k u T1)
                             (open_rec_typ (S k) u T2)
  | typ_nocap => typ_nocap
  end with
open_rec_dec (k: nat) (u: var) (D: dec): dec :=
  match D with
  | dec_typ L T U => dec_typ L (open_rec_typ (S k) u T)
                            (open_rec_typ (S k) u U)
  | dec_fld m T U => dec_fld m (open_rec_typ k u T)
                            (open_rec_typ k u U)
  | dec_met m TC TZ TR =>
    dec_met m (open_rec_typ (S k) u TC) (open_rec_typ k u TZ) (open_rec_typ (S (S k)) u TR)
  end.

Instance TypOpenable : Openable typ := open_rec_typ.

Instance DecOpenable : Openable dec := open_rec_dec.

Fixpoint fv_typ (T: typ) : vars :=
  match T with
  | typ_top        => \{}
  | typ_bot        => \{}
  | typ_rcd D      => (fv_dec D)
  | typ_and T U    => (fv_typ T) \u (fv_typ U)
  | typ_or T U    => (fv_typ T) \u (fv_typ U)
  | typ_sel x L y   => (fv x) \u (fv y)
  | typ_bnd T      => (fv_typ T)
  | typ_fun T1 T2  => (fv_typ T1) \u (fv_typ T2)
  | typ_nocap => \{}
  end with
fv_dec (D: dec) : vars :=
  match D with
  | dec_typ L T U => (fv_typ T) \u (fv_typ U)
  | dec_fld m T U => (fv_typ T) \u (fv_typ U)
  | dec_met m TC TZ TR => (fv_typ TC) \u (fv_typ TZ) \u (fv_typ TR)
  end.

Instance TypFreeVar : FreeVar typ := fv_typ.

Instance DecFreeVar : FreeVar dec := fv_dec.

Fixpoint subst_typ (z: var) (u: var) (T: typ) { struct T } : typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_top        => typ_top
  | typ_bot        => typ_bot
  | typ_rcd D      => typ_rcd (subst_dec z u D)
  | typ_and T1 T2  => typ_and (subst_typ z u T1) (subst_typ z u T2)
  | typ_or T1 T2  => typ_or (subst_typ z u T1) (subst_typ z u T2)
  | typ_sel x L y    => typ_sel (subst_var z u x) L (subst_var z u y)
  | typ_bnd T      => typ_bnd (subst_typ z u T)
  | typ_fun T U    => typ_fun (subst_typ z u T) (subst_typ z u U)
  | typ_nocap => typ_nocap
  end with
subst_dec (z: var) (u: var) (D: dec) { struct D } : dec :=
  match D with
  | dec_typ L T U => dec_typ L (subst_typ z u T) (subst_typ z u U)
  | dec_fld L T U => dec_fld L (subst_typ z u T) (subst_typ z u U)
  | dec_met m TC TZ TR => dec_met m (subst_typ z u TC) (subst_typ z u TZ) (subst_typ z u TR)
  end.

Instance TypSubstVar : SubstVar typ := subst_typ.

Instance DecSubstVar : SubstVar dec := subst_dec.

Fixpoint seal_rec_typ (k: nat) (u: var) (T: typ) {struct T} : typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_top        => typ_top
  | typ_bot        => typ_bot
  | typ_rcd D      => typ_rcd (seal_rec_dec k u D)
  | typ_and T1 T2  => typ_and (seal_rec_typ k u T1)
                             (seal_rec_typ k u T2)
  | typ_or T1 T2  => typ_or (seal_rec_typ k u T1)
                             (seal_rec_typ k u T2)
  | typ_sel x L y => typ_sel (seal_rec k u x) L (seal_rec k u y)
  | typ_bnd T      => typ_bnd (seal_rec_typ (S k) u T)
  | typ_fun T1 T2  => typ_fun (seal_rec_typ k u T1)
                             (seal_rec_typ (S k) u T2)
  | typ_nocap => typ_nocap
  end with
seal_rec_dec (k: nat) (u: var) (D: dec): dec :=
  match D with
  | dec_typ L T U => dec_typ L (seal_rec_typ (S k) u T)
                            (seal_rec_typ (S k) u U)
  | dec_fld m T U => dec_fld m (seal_rec_typ k u T)
                            (seal_rec_typ k u U)
  | dec_met m TC TZ TR =>
    dec_met m (seal_rec_typ (S k) u TC) (seal_rec_typ k u TZ) (seal_rec_typ (S (S k)) u TR)
  end.

Instance TypSealable : Sealable typ := seal_rec_typ.

Instance DecSealable : Sealable dec := seal_rec_dec.

Instance TypAbstractSyntax :
  AbstractSyntax TypOpenable TypFreeVar TypSubstVar := {}.

Instance DecAbstractSyntax :
  AbstractSyntax DecOpenable DecFreeVar DecSubstVar := {}.

Instance DecLabelOf : LabelOf dec :=
  fun D =>
      match D with
      | dec_typ L _ _ => label_typ L
      | dec_fld m _ _ => label_fld m
      | dec_met m _ _ _ => label_met m
      end.

Fixpoint collect_typ {C: Type} (df : C) (f : avar -> C) (comb: C -> C -> C) (T: typ) : C :=
  match T with
  | typ_top        => df
  | typ_bot        => df
  | typ_rcd D      => (collect_dec df f comb D)
  | typ_and T U    => comb (collect_typ df f comb T) (collect_typ df f comb U)
  | typ_or T U    => comb (collect_typ df f comb T) (collect_typ df f comb U)
  | typ_sel x L y    => comb (f x) (f y)
  | typ_bnd T      => (collect_typ df f comb T)
  | typ_fun T1 T2  => comb (collect_typ df f comb T1) (collect_typ df f comb T2)
  | typ_nocap => df
  end with
collect_dec {C: Type} (df : C) (f : avar -> C) (comb: C -> C -> C) (D: dec) : C :=
  match D with
  | dec_typ L T U => comb (collect_typ df f comb T) (collect_typ df f comb U)
  | dec_fld m T U => comb (collect_typ df f comb T) (collect_typ df f comb U)
  | dec_met m TC TZ TR => comb (comb (collect_typ df f comb TC) (collect_typ df f comb TZ)) (collect_typ df f comb TR)
  end.

Instance TypCollect : Collect AvarAbstractSyntax TypAbstractSyntax
  := @collect_typ.

Instance DecCollect : Collect AvarAbstractSyntax DecAbstractSyntax :=
  @collect_dec.

Fixpoint transform_typ (f : avar -> nat -> avar) (T : typ) (n : nat) : typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_top        => typ_top
  | typ_bot        => typ_bot
  | typ_rcd D      => typ_rcd (transform_dec f D n)
  | typ_and T1 T2  => typ_and (transform_typ f T1 n) (transform_typ f T2 n)
  | typ_or T1 T2  => typ_or (transform_typ f T1 n) (transform_typ f T2 n)
  | typ_sel x L y    => typ_sel (f x n) L (f y n)
  | typ_bnd T      => typ_bnd (transform_typ f T (S n))
  | typ_fun T1 T2  => typ_fun (transform_typ f T1 n) (transform_typ f T2 (S n))
  | typ_nocap => typ_nocap
  end with
transform_dec (f : avar -> nat -> avar) (D : dec) (n : nat) : dec :=
  match D with
  | dec_typ L T U => dec_typ L (transform_typ f T (S n)) (transform_typ f U (S n))
  | dec_fld m T U => dec_fld m (transform_typ f T n) (transform_typ f U n)
  | dec_met m TC TZ TR => dec_met m (transform_typ f TC (S n)) (transform_typ f TZ n) (transform_typ f TR (S (S n)))
  end.

Instance TypTransform : Transform AvarAbstractSyntax TypAbstractSyntax :=
  @transform_typ.

Instance DecTransform : Transform AvarAbstractSyntax DecAbstractSyntax :=
  @transform_dec.

Inductive typ_nulary: typ -> Prop :=

Inductive typ_andor: (typ -> typ -> typ) -> Prop :=

Notation typ_binary_rcd_typ_ctor A :=

Inductive typ_binary: (typ -> typ -> typ) -> Prop :=
| typ_binary_and: typ_binary typ_and
| typ_binary_or: typ_binary typ_or
| typ_binary_fun: typ_binary typ_fun
| typ_binary_rcd_typ(A: typ_label): typ_binary (typ_binary_rcd_typ_ctor A)
| typ_binary_rcd_fld(A: fld_label): typ_binary (typ_binary_rcd_fld_ctor A)

Notation typ_notand T := (forall S1 S2, T <> typ_and S1 S2) (only parsing).

Definition typ_notlog T := typ_notor T /\ typ_notand T.

Inductive typ_indep: avar -> typ -> Prop :=
| typ_indep_nulary v T:
  typ_nulary T -> typ_indep v T

| typ_indep_and v t1 t2:
    typ_indep v t1->
    typ_indep v t2->
    typ_indep v (typ_and t1 t2)
| typ_indep_or v t1 t2:
    typ_indep v t1->
    typ_indep v t2->
    typ_indep v (typ_or t1 t2)
| typ_indep_fld v a t1 t2:
    typ_indep v t1->
    typ_indep v t2->
    typ_indep v (typ_rcd (dec_fld a t1 t2))
| typ_indep_typ_f v a t1 t2:
    typ_indep (avar_f v) t1->
    typ_indep (avar_f v) t2->
    typ_indep (avar_f v) (typ_rcd (dec_typ a t1 t2))
| typ_indep_typ_b n a t1 t2:
    typ_indep (avar_b (S n)) t1->
    typ_indep (avar_b (S n)) t2->
    typ_indep (avar_b n) (typ_rcd (dec_typ a t1 t2))
| typ_indep_fun_f v t1 t2:
    typ_indep (avar_f v) t1 ->
    typ_indep (avar_f v) t2 ->
    typ_indep (avar_f v) (typ_fun t1 t2)
| typ_indep_fun_b n t1 t2:
    typ_indep (avar_b n) t1 ->
    typ_indep (avar_b (S n)) t2 ->
    typ_indep (avar_b n) (typ_fun t1 t2)
| typ_indep_sel(v v1 v2: avar)(l: typ_label):
    v <> v1 ->
    v <> v2 ->
    typ_indep v (typ_sel v1 l v2)
| typ_indep_sel_normal(v v1 v2: avar)(l: typ_normal_label):
    v <> v2 ->
    typ_indep v (typ_sel v1 (typ_label_normal l) v2)
| typ_indep_bnd_f v t:
    typ_indep (avar_f v) t ->
    typ_indep (avar_f v) (typ_bnd t)
| typ_indep_bnd_b n t:
    typ_indep (avar_b (S n)) t ->
    typ_indep (avar_b n) (typ_bnd t)
| typ_indep_met_f v t1 t2 t3 l:
    typ_indep (avar_f v) t1 ->
    typ_indep (avar_f v) t2 ->
    typ_indep (avar_f v) t3 ->
    typ_indep (avar_f v) (typ_rcd (dec_met l t1 t2 t3))
| typ_indep_met_b n t1 t2 t3 l:
    typ_indep (avar_b (S n)) t1 ->
    typ_indep (avar_b n) t2 ->
    typ_indep (avar_b (S (S n))) t3 ->
    typ_indep (avar_b n) (typ_rcd (dec_met l t1 t2 t3))
.

Notation typ_indep_f v T := (typ_indep (avar_f v) T).

Notation typ_indep_b n T := (typ_indep (avar_b n) T).

Local Lemma includes_bindings_push G G' x k T :
    includes_bindings G G' ->

Proof.

Local Lemma weaken_core_typing :

      forall G', includes_bindings G G' -> ty_var typing_mode G' Go e x T) /\
    (forall G Go e S T, subtyp typing_mode G Go e S T ->

    (forall G Go e S T, ty_incap typing_mode G Go e S T ->

       fold (@subtyping (subtyp typing_mode)) in *;

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra Vars Terms Heap Env SyntaxClasses TransformCollect Bool.

Inductive frame : Set :=
  | frame_let : trm -> frame.

Inductive stack: Set :=
  | stack_nil: stack
  | stack_cons (f: frame) (fs: stack): stack
.

Fixpoint stack_length (fs : stack) : nat :=
  match fs with
  | stack_nil => 0
  | stack_cons _ fs' => (stack_length fs') + 1
  end.

Definition frame_fv fr := match fr with frame_let c => fv c end.

Instance FrameFreeVar : FreeVar frame := frame_fv.

Fixpoint stack_fv s: vars :=
  match s with
  | stack_nil => \{}
  | stack_cons f fs => (fv f) \u (@fv stack stack_fv fs)
  end.

Instance StackFreeVar : FreeVar stack := stack_fv.

Definition frame_subst_var x y fr :=
  match fr with frame_let c => frame_let (subst_var x y c) end.

Instance FrameSubstVar: SubstVar frame := frame_subst_var.

Fixpoint stack_subst_var x y st :=
  match st with
    | stack_nil => stack_nil
    | stack_cons f fs => stack_cons (subst_var x y f) (@subst_var stack stack_subst_var x y fs)
  end.

Instance StackSubstVar: SubstVar stack := stack_subst_var.

Definition frame_open n x fr :=
  match fr with frame_let c => frame_let (open_rec n x c) end.

Instance FrameOpenable: Openable frame := frame_open.

Fixpoint stack_open n x st :=
  match st with
    | stack_nil => stack_nil
    | stack_cons f fs => stack_cons (open_rec (S n) x f) (@open_rec stack stack_open n x fs)
  end.

Instance StackOpenable:  Openable stack := stack_open.

Instance FrameAbstractSyntax :
  AbstractSyntax FrameOpenable FrameFreeVar FrameSubstVar := {}.

Instance StackAbstractSyntax :
  AbstractSyntax StackOpenable StackFreeVar StackSubstVar := {}.

Definition collect_frame {C: Type} (df : C) (f : avar -> C) (comb: C -> C -> C) (fr: frame) : C :=
  match fr with
  | frame_let t => (collect df f comb t)
  end.

Instance FrameCollect : Collect AvarAbstractSyntax FrameAbstractSyntax :=
  @collect_frame.

Fixpoint collect_stack {C: Type} (df : C) (f : avar -> C) (comb: C -> C -> C) (st: stack) : C :=
  match st with
  | stack_nil => df
  | (stack_cons fr fs) => comb (collect df f comb fr) (@collect _ _ _ _ AvarAbstractSyntax _ _ _ _ StackAbstractSyntax (@collect_stack) C df f comb fs)
  end.

Instance StackCollect : Collect AvarAbstractSyntax StackAbstractSyntax :=
  @collect_stack.

Definition transform_frame (f : avar -> nat -> avar) (fr : frame) (n : nat) : frame :=
  match fr with
  | frame_let t => frame_let (transform f t n)
  end.

Instance FrameTransform : Transform AvarAbstractSyntax FrameAbstractSyntax :=
  @transform_frame.

Fixpoint transform_stack (f : avar -> nat -> avar) (st : stack) (n : nat) : stack :=
  match st with
  | stack_nil => stack_nil
  | (stack_cons fr fs) => (stack_cons (transform f fr (S n)) (@transform _ _ _ _ AvarAbstractSyntax _ _ _ _ StackAbstractSyntax transform_stack f fs n))

  | stack_nil => fs2

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra.

Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.

Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping Indep Equivalence RecordTypes.

Notation typ_objref T S := (typ_and (typ_bnd T) S) (only parsing).

Notation typ_objref_loc typing_mode T := (
  match (mode_refcaps' typing_mode) with
  | mode_refcaps_none => (typ_objref T typ_top)
  | mode_refcaps_mutability => (typ_objref T (typ_mut_marker typ_bot))
  end)(only parsing).

Inductive refcap_inert_mutability: typ -> varkind -> Prop :=
| refacp_inert_mutability_loc: refcap_inert_mutability (typ_mut_marker typ_bot) v_loc
| refacp_inert_mutability_ref Tbnd: refcap_inert_mutability (typ_mut_marker Tbnd) v_ref
.

Definition refcap_inert_type {typing_mode: Mode} T vk :=
  match (mode_refcaps' typing_mode) with
  | mode_refcaps_none => refcap_typ T \{}
  | mode_refcaps_mutability => refcap_inert_mutability T vk
  end.

Notation obj_typ_is cond T S vk := (
      record_type T ->
      refcap_inert_type S vk ->
      typ_indep_b 0 T ->
      cond (typ_objref T S) vk) (only parsing).

Notation fun_typ_is cond S T := (
      cond (typ_fun S T)) (only parsing).

Notation fun_type U := (exists S T, fun_typ_is (eq U) S T) (only parsing).

Notation obj_type typing_mode U := (exists T S, obj_typ_is typing_mode (eq U) T S) (only parsing).

Section WithTypingMode.

Context (typing_mode: Mode).

Inductive inert_vk: varkind -> Prop :=
  | inert_vk_loc: inert_vk v_loc
  | inert_vk_ref: inert_vk v_ref.

Inductive inert_typ: typ -> varkind -> Prop :=

  | inert_typ_fun S T vk:
    mode_has_fun typing_mode ->
    fun_typ_is inert_typ S T vk

  | inert_typ_obj T S vk:
    obj_typ_is inert_typ T S vk.

Definition inert_type T := exists vk, inert_typ T vk.

Inductive inert: ctx -> Prop :=
  | inert_empty: inert ctx_empty
  | inert_push G x vk T:
      inert G ->
      inert_vk vk ->
      inert_typ T vk ->
      x §# G ->
      x \notin ctx_fv G ->
      x \notin fv T ->
      inert (G § x / vk ~ T).

End WithTypingMode.

Arguments inert [typing_mode].

Arguments inert_typ {typing_mode}.

Arguments inert_type {typing_mode}.

Inductive fresh_telescope : ctx -> Prop :=
  | fresh_telescope_empty : fresh_telescope ctx_empty
  | fresh_telescope_push : forall G x vk T,
      fresh_telescope G ->
      x §# G ->
      x \notin ctx_fv G ->
      x \notin fv T ->
      fresh_telescope (G § x / vk ~ T).

Section WithTypingMode.

Context (typing_mode: Mode).

End WithTypingMode.
Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.

Require Import LibExtra.

Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping EnvCorrespondence Visibility TFree ConfigVarkinds Deref HeapInstantiate Indep RecordTypes InertContext RecordDefs Equivalence ConfigNotations.

Section WithTypingMode.

Context (typing_mode: Mode).

Inductive ty_item_s : ctx -> renv -> heap -> var -> Prop :=

| ty_item_fun_s : forall G e s x S t L T,
    mode_has_fun typing_mode ->
    ctx_binds x (typ_fun S T) G ->
    binds x (item_fun t) s ->
    (forall x, x \notin L ->
      G § x / v_par ~ S ⁏e ⊢ open x t ∶ open x T) ->
    all_tfree_k G t v_ref ->
    ty_item_s G e s x
| ty_item_obj_s : forall G e s x U S ds T,
    ctx_binds x T G ->
    binds x (item_obj ds) s ->
    T = typ_objref U S ->
    G §§ (objctx_heap x U) ⁏e ⊢ ds ∶ (open x U) ->
    defs_varkinds G ds ->
    ty_item_s G e s x.

Definition heap_correspond (G : ctx) (e: renv) (s : heap) : Prop :=
  ctx_ok G /\
  ctx_weakens G /\
  ok s /\
  ok e /\
  ctx_kdom v_loc G = dom s /\
  ctx_kdom v_ref G = dom e /\
  renv_corr G e /\
  (forall x,
      x \in dom s ->
      ty_item_s G e s x).

End WithTypingMode.

Arguments heap_correspond {typing_mode}.

Notation inert_G_for_item G w y T := (G § y / v_loc ~ T § w / v_ref ~ T).

Notation inert_G_for_obj G w y T S := (inert_G_for_item G w y (typ_objref T S)).

Notation heap_prefix S1 S2 := (exists S1', S2 = concat S1 S1').

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra SyntaxClasses.

Require Import Vars TransformCollect Types.

Require Import Coq.Sets.Ensembles.

Require Import Coq.Sets.Constructive_sets.

Inductive ctx: Set :=

| ctx_empty

| ctx_push: ctx -> var -> varkind -> typ -> ctx

| ctx_stop: ctx -> ctx

| ctx_hide: ctx -> ctx
.

Notation "G '§' v / vk ~ T" := (ctx_push G v vk T)
  (at level 30, vk at level 20, v at level 20, T at level 20).

Notation "v / vk ~ T" := (ctx_push ctx_empty v vk T)
  (at level 30, vk at level 20, T at level 20).

Notation "G '§ʸ' v ~ T" := (ctx_push G v v_loc T)
  (at level 30, v at level 20, T at level 20).

Notation "G '§ʷ' v ~ T" := (ctx_push G v v_ref T)
  (at level 30, v at level 20, T at level 20).

Notation "x '§#' E" := (x \notin (ctx_dom E)) (at level 67) : env_scope.

Inductive ctx_ok: ctx -> Prop :=
| ctx_ok_empty:
  ctx_ok ctx_empty
| ctx_ok_push(G: ctx)(v: var)(vk: varkind)(t: typ):
  ctx_ok G ->
  v §# G ->
  ctx_ok (ctx_push G v vk t)
| ctx_ok_stop(G: ctx):
  ctx_ok G -> ctx_ok (ctx_stop G)
| ctx_ok_hide(G: ctx):
  ctx_ok G -> ctx_ok (ctx_hide G)
.

Inductive ctx_weakens: ctx -> Prop :=
| ctx_weakens_empty: ctx_weakens ctx_empty
| ctx_weakens_push G v vk t:
  ctx_weakens G ->
  ctx_weakens (ctx_push G v vk t)
.

Inductive ctx_weakens_hide: ctx -> Prop :=
| ctx_weakens_hide_empty: ctx_weakens_hide ctx_empty
| ctx_weakens_hide_push G v vk t:
    ctx_weakens_hide G ->
    ctx_weakens_hide (ctx_push G v vk t)
| ctx_weakens_hide_hide G:
    ctx_weakens_hide G ->
    ctx_weakens_hide (ctx_hide G)
.


Inductive ctx_binds_k_after: var -> varkind -> typ -> ctx -> ctx -> Prop :=
| ctx_binds_k_e(v: var)(vk: varkind)(t: typ)(G: ctx):
    ctx_binds_k_after v vk t (ctx_push G v vk t) G
| ctx_binds_k_n(v v2: var)(vk1 vk2: varkind)(t t2: typ)(G1 G2: ctx):
    v <> v2 ->
    ctx_binds_k_after v vk1 t G1 G2 ->
    ctx_binds_k_after v vk1 t (ctx_push G1 v2 vk2 t2) G2
.

Fixpoint ctx_kdom(vk: varkind)(c: ctx): fset var :=
match c with
| ctx_empty => \{}
| ctx_push c v vk2 t => If (vk = vk2) then (\{ v } \u (ctx_kdom vk c)) else (ctx_kdom vk c)
| ctx_stop c => ctx_kdom vk c
| ctx_hide c => ctx_kdom vk c
end.

Definition ctx_k G v vk:=
  exists t G2, ctx_binds_k_after v vk t G G2.

   subtype premises can extend that context with abstract parameters. *)
Local Fixpoint uses_exact_selection {F Go e S T}
    (d : subtyp typing_mode F Go e S T) : Prop :=
  match d with
  | @subtyp_trans _ _ _ _ _ _ p q
  | @subtyp_and2 _ _ _ _ _ _ p q
  | @subtyp_or2 _ _ _ _ _ _ p q
  | @subtyp_fld _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ p q =>
      uses_exact_selection p /\ uses_exact_selection q
  | @subtyp_typ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ p q =>
      (forall v, uses_exact_selection (p v)) /\
      (forall v, uses_exact_selection (q v))
  | @subtyp_sel1 _ G g x a _ L U _
  | @subtyp_sel2 _ G g x a _ L U _ =>
      exact_type_declaration G g x a L U
  | _ => True
  end.

  exists d : subtyp typing_mode F objctx_empty e S T, uses_exact_selection d.

item.text: The write case now checks without extra assumptions. Rocq verified that a well-typed write preserves configuration typing and that any mutable reachability after the write already held before it. I’ll check the resulting trace theorem for prefixes containing writes and let-frame pushes.

/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path(\"Task.v\")
s = p.read_text()
i = s.index(\"Local Definition is_let_push\")
j = s.index(\"Theorem immutability_guarantee\", i)
s = s[:i] + r'''Local Definition starts_with_let_or_write C :=
  match C with
  | (trm_let _ _ ; _ ; _ ; _ ; _)
  | (trm_write _ _ _ ; _ ; _ ; _ ; _) => True
  | _ => False
  end.

Local Lemma let_push_or_write_preserves F C D T :
    ty_config F C T ->
    C ↦ D ->
    starts_with_let_or_write C ->
    ty_config F D T /\\ (forall y, F ⊢ D mreach y -> F ⊢ C mreach y).
Proof.
  intros Hty Hstep. destruct Hstep; simpl; intros Hguard; try contradiction.
  - eapply write_step_typing_and_reachability; eassumption.
  - split.
    + now apply let_push_preservation.
    + intros y Hy. eapply reachability_let_push; exact Hy.
Qed.

Local Lemma let_push_write_trace_preservation F C D n T :
    ty_config F C T ->
    C ⊣ n ↦* D ->
    (forall k A B, C ⊣ k ↦* A -> A ↦ B -> k < n -> starts_with_let_or_write A) ->
    ty_config F D T /\\ (forall y, F ⊢ D mreach y -> F ⊢ C mreach y).
Proof.
  intros Hty Hsteps.
  induction Hsteps as [C | C A B k Hprefix IH Hstep]; intros Hall.
  - auto.
  - assert (Hprev : ty_config F A T /\\ (forall y, F ⊢ A mreach y -> F ⊢ C mreach y)).
    { apply IH; [exact Hty |].
      intros j M N Hj Hstep' Hlt.
      eapply Hall; [exact Hj | exact Hstep' | now apply Nat.lt_lt_succ_r]. }
    destruct Hprev as [HtyA Hreach].
    destruct (let_push_or_write_preserves HtyA Hstep
                (Hall k A B Hprefix Hstep (Nat.lt_succ_diag_r k))) as [HtyB Hreach'].
    split; [exact HtyB |].
    intros y Hy. apply Hreach, Hreach'. exact Hy.
Qed.

Local Lemma immutability_after_let_pushes_and_writes F C D n T y ds :
    binds y (item_obj ds) (config_heap C) ->
    ty_config F C T ->
    C ⊣ n ↦* D ->
    (forall k A B, C ⊣ k ↦* A -> A ↦ B ->
      Datatypes.S k < n -> starts_with_let_or_write A) ->
    binds y (item_obj ds) (config_heap D) \\/ F ⊢ C mreach y.
Proof.
  intros Hbind Hty Hsteps Hall.
  eapply immutability_from_typed_prefixes; [exact Hbind | exact Hsteps |].
  intros k A Hpath Hlt.
  assert (Hprefix : forall j M N,
    C ⊣ j ↦* M -> M ↦ N -> j < k -> starts_with_let_or_write M).
  { intros j M N Hpath' Hstep Hjk.
    eapply Hall; [exact Hpath' | exact Hstep |].
    eapply Nat.le_lt_trans; [exact Hjk | exact Hlt]. }
  destruct (let_push_write_trace_preservation Hty Hpath Hprefix) as [HtyA Hreach].
  exists F, T. split; [exact HtyA | apply Hreach].
Qed.

    ty_config F C T ->
    C ↦ D ->
    starts_with_let_or_write C ->
    ty_config F D T /\\ (forall y, F ⊢ D mreach y -> F ⊢ C mreach y).
Proof.
  intros Hty Hstep. destruct Hstep; simpl; intros Hguard; try contradiction.
  - eapply write_step_typing_and_reachability; eassumption.
  - split.
    + now apply let_push_preservation.
    + intros y Hy. eapply reachability_let_push; exact Hy.
Qed.

Local Lemma let_push_write_trace_preservation F C D n T :
    ty_config F C T ->
    C ⊣ n ↦* D ->
    (forall k A B, C ⊣ k ↦* A -> A ↦ B -> k < n -> starts_with_let_or_write A) ->
    ty_config F D T /\\ (forall y, F ⊢ D mreach y -> F ⊢ C mreach y).
Proof.
  intros Hty Hsteps.
  induction Hsteps as [C | C A B k Hprefix IH Hstep]; intros Hall.
  - auto.
  - assert (Hprev : ty_config F A T /\\ (forall y, F ⊢ A mreach y -> F ⊢ C mreach y)).
    { apply IH; [exact Hty |].
      intros j M N Hj Hstep' Hlt.
      eapply Hall; [exact Hj | exact Hstep' | now apply Nat.lt_lt_succ_r]. }
    destruct Hprev as [HtyA Hreach].
    destruct (let_push_or_write_preserves HtyA Hstep
                (Hall k A B Hprefix Hstep (Nat.lt_succ_diag_r k))) as [HtyB Hreach'].
    split; [exact HtyB |].
    intros y Hy. apply Hreach, Hreach'. exact Hy.
Qed.

Local Lemma immutability_after_let_pushes_and_writes F C D n T y ds :
    binds y (item_obj ds) (config_heap C) ->
    ty_config F C T ->
    C ⊣ n ↦* D ->
    (forall k A B, C ⊣ k ↦* A -> A ↦ B ->
      Datatypes.S k < n -> starts_with_let_or_write A) ->
    binds y (item_obj ds) (config_heap D) \\/ F ⊢ C mreach y.
Proof.
  intros Hbind Hty Hsteps Hall.
  eapply immutability_from_typed_prefixes; [exact Hbind | exact Hsteps |].
  intros k A Hpath Hlt.
  assert (Hprefix : forall j M N,
    C ⊣ j ↦* M -> M ↦ N -> j < k -> starts_with_let_or_write M).
  { intros j M N Hpath' Hstep Hjk.
    eapply Hall; [exact Hpath' | exact Hstep |].
    eapply Nat.le_lt_trans; [exact Hjk | exact Hlt]. }
  destruct (let_push_write_trace_preservation Hty Hpath Hprefix) as [HtyA Hreach].
  exists F, T. split; [exact HtyA | apply Hreach].
Qed.

Rocq verifies the write case and the immutability guarantee for traces whose steps before the final reduction are writes or let-frame pushes. [Task.v](/workspace/Task.v:2752)

The unrestricted `immutability_guarantee` remains open, so `make` still fails. Reads and allocations still need typing preservation and backward reachability proofs. Method calls and popping let frames still need typing preservation.
I’ll continue with substitution in the typing rules. That’s the missing piece for let-pop and method-call preservation, and it also helps with the fresh names introduced by reads and allocations.

Local Lemma term_open_commutes_mutual :
    (forall t : trm, forall k l x y, k <> l ->
       open_rec k x (open_rec l y t) = open_rec l y (open_rec k x t)) /\
    (forall a : lit, forall k l x y, k <> l ->
       open_rec k x (open_rec l y a) = open_rec l y (open_rec k x a)) /\
    (forall d : def, forall k l x y, k <> l ->
       open_rec k x (open_rec l y d) = open_rec l y (open_rec k x d)) /\
    (forall ds : defs, forall k l x y, k <> l ->
       open_rec k x (open_rec l y ds) = open_rec l y (open_rec k x ds)).
Proof.
  apply trm_mutind; intros;
    cbn [open_rec TrmOpenable LitOpenable DefOpenable DefsOpenable
      open_rec_trm open_rec_lit open_rec_def open_rec_defs];
    f_equal; eauto using avar_open_commute, type_open_commute; congruence.
Qed.

Inductive red : config -> config -> Prop :=

| red_read : forall yObj wObj m Sigma e Lv yVal wVal ds fs,
    fresh_in_config (wVal :: nil) (trm_read (avar_f wObj) m; fs ; Sigma; e; Lv) ->
    binds wObj yObj e ->
    binds yObj (item_obj ds) Sigma ->
    defs_has ds (def_fld m (avar_f yVal)) ->
    (trm_read (avar_f wObj) m; fs ; Sigma; e; Lv)
      ↦ (trm_var (avar_f wVal); fs; Sigma; e & wVal ~ yVal; fv_config (trm_read (avar_f wObj) m; fs ; Sigma; e; Lv))

| red_write : forall yObj wObj m Sigma e Lv yArg wArg Sigma' fs,
    heap_update Sigma yObj m yArg Sigma' ->
    binds wObj yObj e ->
    binds wArg yArg e ->
    (trm_write (avar_f wObj) m (avar_f wArg); fs; Sigma; e; Lv)
      ↦ (trm_var (avar_f wArg); fs ; Sigma'; e; fv_config (trm_write (avar_f wObj) m (avar_f wArg); fs; Sigma; e; Lv))

| red_call : forall yObj wObj m Sigma e Lv wArg t ds fs,
    binds yObj (item_obj ds) Sigma ->
    defs_has ds (def_met m t) ->
    binds wObj yObj e ->
    (trm_call (avar_f wObj) m (avar_f wArg); fs ; Sigma; e; Lv)
      ↦ ((open wArg (open_rec 1 wObj t)); fs ; Sigma; e; fv_config (trm_call (avar_f wObj) m (avar_f wArg); fs ; Sigma; e; Lv))

| red_apply : forall yFun wFun wArg Sigma e Lv t fs,
    binds yFun (item_fun t) Sigma ->
    binds wFun yFun e ->
    (trm_apply (avar_f wFun) (avar_f wArg); fs; Sigma; e; Lv)
      ↦ (open wArg t; fs; Sigma; e; fv_config (trm_apply (avar_f wFun) (avar_f wArg); fs; Sigma; e; Lv))

| red_let_fun : forall T t1 t2 Sigma e Lv y w fs,
    fresh_in_config (y :: w :: nil) (trm_lit (lit_fun T t1) t2 ; fs; Sigma; e; Lv) ->
    y <> w ->
    (trm_lit (lit_fun T t1) t2 ; fs; Sigma; e; Lv)
      ↦ (open w t2 ; fs; Sigma & y ~ (item_fun t1); e & w ~ y ; fv_config (trm_lit (lit_fun T t1) t2 ; fs; Sigma; e; Lv))

| red_let_obj : forall T ds t Sigma e Lv y w fs,
    fresh_in_config (y :: w :: nil) (trm_lit (lit_obj T ds) t ; fs; Sigma; e; Lv) ->
    w <> y ->
    (trm_lit (lit_obj T ds) t ; fs; Sigma; e; Lv)
      ↦ (open w t ; fs; Sigma & y ~ (item_obj (deref_defs (e & w ~ y) (open w ds))); e & w ~ y ; fv_config (trm_lit (lit_obj T ds) t ; fs; Sigma; e; Lv))

| red_let_var : forall t Sigma e Lv x fs,
    (trm_var (avar_f x); (stack_cons (frame_let t) fs); Sigma; e; Lv)
      ↦ (open x t; fs; Sigma; e ; fv_config (trm_var (avar_f x); (stack_cons (frame_let t) fs); Sigma; e; Lv))

| red_let_push : forall s t fs Sigma e Lv,
    (trm_let s t; fs; Sigma; e; Lv)
      ↦ (s; (stack_cons (frame_let t) fs); Sigma; e ; fv_config (trm_let s t; fs; Sigma; e; Lv))

where "t1 ↦ t2" := (red t1 t2).

Inductive answer: config -> Prop :=
| nf_loc: forall x Sigma e Lv, answer (trm_var (avar_f x); stack_nil; Sigma; e; Lv).

Reserved Notation "C1 ⊣ n ↦* C2"

Inductive red_closure :  config -> nat -> config -> Prop :=

| red_refl : forall (C : config),
    C ⊣ 0 ↦* C

| red_trans : forall (C1 C2 C3 : config) (n : nat),
    C1 ⊣ n ↦* C2 ->
    C2      ↦  C3 ->
    C1 ⊣ S n ↦* C3

where "C1 ⊣ n ↦* C2" := (red_closure C1 n C2).

Definition config_terminates_in C n :=
 (exists (Ca : config), answer Ca /\ (C ⊣n↦* Ca)).

Definition config_terminates C :=
 (exists (n : nat), config_terminates_in C n).

Inductive object_view := declaration_view | capability_view.

(* The declaration view tracks the shape of an actual object. The capability
   view tracks the upper bound of its mutable capability independently. *)
Inductive object_has_view (F : ctx) (e : renv) (x : var) (R B : typ)
    : object_view -> typ -> Prop :=
| view_top v : object_has_view F e x R B v typ_top
| view_and v A C :
    object_has_view F e x R B v A ->
    object_has_view F e x R B v C ->
    object_has_view F e x R B v (typ_and A C)
| view_or_left v A C :
    object_has_view F e x R B v A ->
    object_has_view F e x R B v (typ_or A C)
| view_or_right v A C :
    object_has_view F e x R B v C ->
    object_has_view F e x R B v (typ_or A C)
| view_normal_selection v w a z L U :
    exact_type_declaration F e w (typ_label_normal a) L U ->
    object_has_view F e x R B v (open z U) ->
    object_has_view F e x R B v (typ_sel (avar_f w) (typ_label_normal a) (avar_f z))
| view_record_declaration actual requested :
    record_has (open (canonical_location e x) R) actual ->
    interface_bounds F e actual requested ->
    object_has_view F e x R B declaration_view (typ_rcd requested)
| view_declaration_capability a L U :
    object_has_view F e x R B declaration_view
      (typ_rcd (dec_typ (typ_label_refcap a) L U))
| view_capability_member a L U :
    object_has_view F e x R B capability_view
      (typ_rcd (dec_typ (typ_label_normal a) L U))
| view_capability_field a L U :
    object_has_view F e x R B capability_view (typ_rcd (dec_fld a L U))
| view_capability_method a C Z T :
    object_has_view F e x R B capability_view (typ_rcd (dec_met a C Z T))
| view_capability_bounds L U :
    (forall z, exact_subtype F e (open z L) typ_bot) ->
    (forall z, exact_subtype F e (open z B) (open z U)) ->
    object_has_view F e x R B capability_view (typ_rcd (dec_typ typ_label_mutability L U))
| view_nocap :
    (mode_has_top_nm_complement typing_mode ->
      ~ (forall z, exact_subtype F e (open z B) typ_bot)) ->
    object_has_view F e x R B capability_view typ_nocap
| view_declaration_rec T :
    object_has_view F e x R B declaration_view (open (canonical_location e x) T) ->
    object_has_view F e x R B capability_view (open (canonical_location e x) T) ->
    object_has_view F e x R B declaration_view (typ_bnd T)

    object_has_view F e x R B capability_view (typ_bnd T).

    heap_update S yObj a yArg S' ->
    binds wArg yArg e ->
    (F ⁏ e ⊢ trm_var (avar_f yObj) ∶ typ_rcd (dec_fld a typ_bot (typ_mut_marker typ_bot)) ->

Proof.
  intros Hupdate Harg Hmutable Hr.
  change (mut_reach typing_mode F (trm_var (avar_f wArg) ; s ; S' ; e ; Lv') y) in Hr.
  remember (trm_var (avar_f wArg) ; s ; S' ; e ; Lv') as C' eqn:Heq.
  induction Hr; inversion Heq; subst.
  - match goal with
    | Hbind : binds ?z (item_obj _) S', Hhas : defs_has _ _ |- _ =>
        destruct (write_field_origin Hupdate Hbind Hhas)
          as [(-> & -> & ->) | [ds0 [Hbind0 Hhas0]]]
    end.
    + eapply mreach_trm with (w := wArg); eauto.
      left. apply tfree_trm_write_r.
    + eapply mreach_fld; eauto.
  - eapply mreach_trm; try eassumption.

      destruct Hfree as [Hfree | Hfree]; [left | now right];
      inversion Hfree; subst; apply tfree_trm_write_r

Proof.
  intros Hcfg Hupdate Hobj Harg Hbounds. cbn zeta.
  assert (Hheap : heap_correspond F e S) by (inversion Hcfg; assumption).
  assert (Hwrite : exists T, F ⁏ e ⊢ trm_write (avar_f wObj) a (avar_f wArg) ∶ T)
    by (inversion Hcfg; eauto).
  pose proof Hheap as (Hok & _ & _ & _ & _ & _ & Henv & _).
  assert (Hdecl : exists R M A, ctx_binds yObj (typ_objref R M) F /\
                            record_has (open yObj R) (dec_fld a A A)).
  { destruct Hupdate as (_ & _ & _ & _ & ds & ds' & Hbind & Hup & _).
    destruct (original_update_field Hup) as [v Hv].
    eapply heap_field_annotation; eassumption. }
  destruct Hdecl as [R [M [A [Hdecl Hfield]]]].
  split.
  - eapply write_preservation_with_field_typing; try eassumption.
    + intros T Hty.
      destruct (write_typing_operands Hty (eq_refl (trm_write (avar_f wObj) a (avar_f wArg))))
        as [L [B [Hvis [Hleft [Hright Hres]]]]].
      pose proof (reference_typing_at_location Hok Henv Hobj Hleft) as Hleft'.
      destruct (Hbounds _ _ _ _ _ Hdecl Hfield Hleft') as [HL HB].
      apply ty_trm_var; [exact Hvis |].
      eapply ty_var_sub; [exact Hright |].
      eapply subtyp_trans; [exact HL |].
      eapply subtyp_trans; eassumption.
    + intros R' M' A' Hdecl' Hfield'.
      destruct Hwrite as [T Hty].
      destruct (write_typing_operands Hty (eq_refl (trm_write (avar_f wObj) a (avar_f wArg))))
        as [L [B [_ [Hleft [Hright _]]]]].
      pose proof (reference_typing_at_location Hok Henv Hobj Hleft) as Hleft'.
      destruct (Hbounds _ _ _ _ _ Hdecl' Hfield' Hleft') as [HL _].
      eapply ty_var_sub; [| exact HL].
      eapply reference_typing_at_location; eassumption.
  - intros y Hr. eapply reachability_write; [exact Hupdate | exact Harg | | exact Hr].
    intros Hcap.
    destruct Hwrite as [T Hty].
    destruct (write_typing_operands Hty (eq_refl (trm_write (avar_f wObj) a (avar_f wArg))))
      as [L [B [Hvis [Hleft [Hright _]]]]].
    pose proof (reference_typing_at_location Hok Henv Hobj Hleft) as Hleft'.
    pose proof (variable_term_typing Hcap (eq_refl (trm_var (avar_f yObj)))) as Hcap'.
    destruct (Hbounds _ _ _ _ _ Hdecl Hfield Hleft') as [HL _].
    destruct (Hbounds _ _ _ _ _ Hdecl Hfield Hcap') as [_ HR].
    apply ty_trm_var; [exact Hvis |].
    eapply ty_var_sub; [exact Hright |].
    eapply subtyp_trans; eassumption.
Qed.

Local Lemma write_step_typing_and_reachability F s S S' e Lv wObj wArg a yObj yArg U :
    ty_config F (trm_write (avar_f wObj) a (avar_f wArg) ; s ; S ; e ; Lv) U ->
    heap_update S yObj a yArg S' ->
    binds wObj yObj e ->
    binds wArg yArg e ->
    let C' := (trm_var (avar_f wArg) ; s ; S' ; e ;
                 fv_config (trm_write (avar_f wObj) a (avar_f wArg) ; s ; S ; e ; Lv)) in
    ty_config F C' U /\
    (forall y, F ⊢ C' mreach y ->
      F ⊢ (trm_write (avar_f wObj) a (avar_f wArg) ; s ; S ; e ; Lv) mreach y).
Proof.
  intros Hcfg Hupdate Hobj Harg.
  eapply write_step_with_field_bounds; try eassumption.
  assert (Hinert : inert F) by (inversion Hcfg; assumption).
  assert (Hheap : heap_correspond F e S) by (inversion Hcfg; assumption).
  eapply field_declaration_gives_bounds; [exact Hinert | exact Hheap |].
  exact (proj2 (environment_binding_canonical_locations Hheap Hobj)).
Qed.

Local Lemma reachability_read F F' s S e Lv Lv' wObj wVal a yObj yVal ds y :
    inert F ->
    binds wObj yObj e ->
    binds yObj (item_obj ds) S ->
    defs_has ds (def_fld a (avar_f yVal)) ->
    (forall w, w <> wVal ->
      F' ⁏ (e & wVal ~ yVal) ⊢ trm_var (avar_f w) ∶ typ_mut_marker typ_bot ->
      F ⁏ e ⊢ trm_var (avar_f w) ∶ typ_mut_marker typ_bot) ->
    (forall x l,
      F' ⁏ (e & wVal ~ yVal) ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x)
        ∶ typ_rcd (dec_fld l typ_bot (typ_mut_marker typ_bot)) ->
      F ⁏ e ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x)
        ∶ typ_rcd (dec_fld l typ_bot (typ_mut_marker typ_bot))) ->
    (F' ⁏ (e & wVal ~ yVal) ⊢ trm_var (avar_f wVal) ∶ typ_mut_marker typ_bot ->
      F ⁏ e ⊢ trm_var (avar_f wObj) ∶ typ_mut_marker typ_bot /\
      F ⁏ e ⊢ trm_var (avar_f yObj) ∶ typ_rcd (dec_fld a typ_bot (typ_mut_marker typ_bot))) ->
    F' ⊢ (trm_var (avar_f wVal) ; s ; S ; e & wVal ~ yVal ; Lv') mreach y ->
    F ⊢ (trm_read (avar_f wObj) a ; s ; S ; e ; Lv) mreach y.
Proof.
  intros Hinert Hobj Hheap Hhas Hrefs Hfields Hnew Hr.
  change (mut_reach typing_mode F'
    (trm_var (avar_f wVal) ; s ; S ; e & wVal ~ yVal ; Lv') y) in Hr.
  remember (trm_var (avar_f wVal) ; s ; S ; e & wVal ~ yVal ; Lv') as C' eqn:Heq.
  remember F' as post eqn:Hctx in Hr.
  induction Hr; inversion Heq; inversion Hctx; subst.
  - eapply mreach_fld; eauto.
  - match goal with Hbind : binds _ _ (e & wVal ~ yVal) |- _ =>
      apply binds_push_inv in Hbind as [[-> ->] | [Hneq Hbind]]
    end.
    + eapply mreach_fld; try eassumption.
      * eapply mreach_trm with (w := wObj); try eassumption.
        -- left. apply tfree_trm_read.
        -- apply (proj1 (Hnew ltac:(eassumption))).
      * apply (proj2 (Hnew ltac:(eassumption))).
    + eapply mreach_trm; try eassumption.
      * match goal with Hfree : tfree _ _ \/ tfree _ _ |- _ =>
          destruct Hfree as [Hfree | Hfree]; [| now right];
          inversion Hfree; subst; contradiction
        end.
      * eapply Hrefs; eassumption.
Qed.

Local Lemma immutability_step C C' F T y ds :
    binds y (item_obj ds) (config_heap C) ->
    ty_config F C T ->
    C ↦ C' ->
    binds y (item_obj ds) (config_heap C') \/ F ⊢ C mreach y.

Local Lemma closed_frame_body t s x :
    closed (stack_cons (frame_let t) s) ->
    closed (open x t) /\ closed s.
Proof.
  intros Hclosed.
  assert (Hparts : forall n z, open_rec (S n) z t = t /\ open_rec n z s = s).
  { intros n z. pose proof (Hclosed n z) as Hopen.
    change (stack_cons (frame_let (open_rec (S n) z t)) (open_rec n z s) =
            stack_cons (frame_let t) s) in Hopen.
    injection Hopen; auto. }
  split; intros n z.
  - destruct n as [| n].
    + apply (proj1 term_open_absorbs_mutual).
    + rewrite (proj1 term_open_commutes_mutual t (S n) 0 z x) by discriminate.
      now rewrite (proj1 (Hparts n z)).
  - exact (proj2 (Hparts n z)).
Qed.

Local Lemma substitution_context G e z x A :
    z §# G ->
    z \notin ctx_fv G ->
    z \notin fv A ->
    G ⁏ e ⊢ x ∶ A ->
    ctx_vis G x ->
    renamed_context (replace_name (fun p => p) z x) (G § z / v_let ~ A) G e.
Proof.
  intros Hz Hctx HA Hx Hvis. split.
  - intros y B Hb. inversion Hb; subst.
    + rewrite replace_name_at.
      rewrite rename_typ_inactive by now apply replace_name_fresh.
      exact Hx.
    + rewrite replace_name_away by assumption.
      rewrite rename_typ_inactive.
      * apply ty_var_var; assumption.
      * apply replace_name_fresh. intros Hbad. apply Hctx.
        eapply bound_type_free_in_context; eassumption.
  - intros y Hy. inversion Hy; subst.
    + now rewrite replace_name_at.
    + now rewrite replace_name_away by assumption.
Qed.

Local Lemma instantiate_let_body G e L (t : trm) A B x :
    (forall z, z \notin L -> G § z / v_let ~ A ⁏ e ⊢ open z t ∶ B) ->
    G ⁏ e ⊢ x ∶ A ->
    ctx_vis G x ->
    G ⁏ e ⊢ open x t ∶ B.
Proof.
  intros Hbody Hx Hvis.
  destruct (var_fresh
    (L \u ctx_dom G \u ctx_fv G \u fv_renv e \u fv t \u fv A \u fv B)) as [z Hz].
  rewrite !notin_union in Hz.
  destruct Hz as (HzL & HzDom & HzCtx & [HzED HzER] & Hzt & HzA & HzB).
  set (f := replace_name (fun p => p) z x).
  assert (Hfix : renaming_fixes_outside \{z} f).
  { intros y Hy. rewrite notin_singleton in Hy. now apply replace_name_away. }
  assert (Haliases : renaming_respects_aliases f e e).
  { unfold f. apply replace_name_respects_aliases.
    - apply notin_union; auto.
    - intros a b Hb. now apply tyq_var_binds. }
  assert (Hscope : renamed_context f (G § z / v_let ~ A) G e)
    by (unfold f; now apply substitution_context).
  pose proof (proj1 term_typing_renaming _ _ _ _ _ (Hbody z HzL)
    f \{z} G e Hfix Haliases Hscope Hscope) as Hopened.
  cbn [rename_objctx] in Hopened.
  rewrite rename_trm_opens in Hopened.
  assert (Hfz : f z = x) by apply replace_name_at.
  rewrite Hfz in Hopened.
  rewrite rename_trm_inactive in Hopened by (unfold f; now apply replace_name_fresh).
  rewrite rename_typ_inactive in Hopened by (unfold f; now apply replace_name_fresh).
  exact Hopened.
Qed.

Local Lemma let_pop_preservation F x t s S e Lv U :
    ty_config F (trm_var (avar_f x) ; stack_cons (frame_let t) s ; S ; e ; Lv) U ->
    ty_config F (open x t ; s ; S ; e ;
      fv_config (trm_var (avar_f x) ; stack_cons (frame_let t) s ; S ; e ; Lv)) U.
Proof.
  intros Hcfg. inversion Hcfg; subst.
  match goal with Hs : ty_stack F e _ (stack_cons (frame_let t) s) U |- _ =>
    inversion Hs; subst
  end.
  assert (Hvisible : ctx_vis F x).
  { eapply kind_bound_visible.
    match goal with Hfree : all_tfree_k_trm F (trm_var (avar_f x)) v_ref |- _ =>
      apply Hfree; apply tfree_trm_var
    end. }
  match goal with Htail : ty_stack F e ?B s U |- _ =>
    eapply ty_config_c with (T := B)
  end; try eassumption.
  - intros w Hfree.
    match goal with Hframe : all_tfree_k_stack F (stack_cons (frame_let t) s) v_ref |- _ =>
      apply Hframe; now apply tfree_stack_cons_r
    end.
  - eapply instantiate_let_body; [eassumption | | exact Hvisible].
    eapply variable_term_typing; [eassumption | reflexivity].
  - intros w Hfree. apply (proj1 tfree_opened_mutual) in Hfree as [Hbodyfree | ->].
    + match goal with Hframe : all_tfree_k_stack F (stack_cons (frame_let t) s) v_ref |- _ =>
        apply Hframe; now apply tfree_stack_cons_l
      end.
    + match goal with Hvar : all_tfree_k_trm F (trm_var (avar_f x)) v_ref |- _ =>
        apply Hvar; apply tfree_trm_var
      end.
  - exact (@carry_config_names F U
       (trm_var (avar_f x) ; stack_cons (frame_let t) s ; S ; e ; Lv)
       (open x t ; s ; S ; e ;
        fv_config (trm_var (avar_f x) ; stack_cons (frame_let t) s ; S ; e ; Lv))
       eq_refl ltac:(assumption)).
  - exact (@carry_config_null
       (trm_var (avar_f x) ; stack_cons (frame_let t) s ; S ; e ; Lv)
       (open x t ; s ; S ; e ;
        fv_config (trm_var (avar_f x) ; stack_cons (frame_let t) s ; S ; e ; Lv))
       eq_refl ltac:(assumption)).
  - match goal with Hclosed : config_closed _ |- _ => inversion Hclosed; subst end.
    destruct (@closed_frame_body t s x ltac:(assumption)) as [Hterm Hstack].
    constructor; assumption.
Qed.

Local Lemma closed_definitions_member ds d :
    closed ds -> defs_has ds d -> closed d.
Proof.
  induction ds as [| ds IH last]; intros Hclosed Hmember.
  - discriminate.
  - unfold defs_has in Hmember. simpl get_def in Hmember.
    assert (Hparts : forall n z,
      open_rec n z ds = ds /\ open_rec n z last = last).
    { intros n z. pose proof (Hclosed n z) as Hopen.
      change (defs_cons (open_rec n z ds) (open_rec n z last) =
              defs_cons ds last) in Hopen.
      injection Hopen; auto. }
    destruct (classic (label_of last = label_of d)) as [Heq | Hneq].
    + rewrite If_l in Hmember by exact Heq. inversion Hmember; subst.
      intros n z. exact (proj2 (Hparts n z)).
    + rewrite If_r in Hmember by exact Hneq.
      apply IH; [| exact Hmember].
      intros n z. exact (proj1 (Hparts n z)).
Qed.

Local Lemma method_body_closed_after_opening m t x y :
    closed (def_met m t) ->
    closed (open_met x y t).
Proof.
  intros Hclosed n z. destruct n as [| n].
  - apply (proj1 term_open_absorbs_mutual).
  - rewrite (proj1 term_open_commutes_mutual (open_rec 1 y t) (S n) 0 z x)
      by discriminate.
    destruct n as [| n].
    + rewrite (proj1 term_open_absorbs_mutual t 1 z y). reflexivity.
    + rewrite (proj1 term_open_commutes_mutual t (S (S n)) 1 z y)
        by congruence.
      pose proof (Hclosed n z) as Hopen.
      change (def_met m (open_rec (S (S n)) z t) = def_met m t) in Hopen.
      injection Hopen. intros ->. reflexivity.
Qed.

Local Lemma call_preservation_with_body_typing F s S e Lv wObj wArg m t U yObj ds :
    ty_config F (trm_call (avar_f wObj) m (avar_f wArg) ; s ; S ; e ; Lv) U ->
    binds yObj (item_obj ds) S ->
    defs_has ds (def_met m t) ->
    (forall T, F ⁏ e ⊢ trm_call (avar_f wObj) m (avar_f wArg) ∶ T ->
               F ⁏ e ⊢ open_met wArg wObj t ∶ T) ->
    ty_config F (open_met wArg wObj t ; s ; S ; e ;
      fv_config (trm_call (avar_f wObj) m (avar_f wArg) ; s ; S ; e ; Lv)) U.
Proof.
  intros Hcfg Hbind Hmethod Hbody.
  inversion Hcfg; subst.
  eapply ty_config_c with (T := T); try eassumption.
  - now apply Hbody.
  - intros w Hfree. apply H9.
    destruct (proj1 tfree_opened_mutual (open_rec 1 wObj t) 0 wArg w Hfree)
      as [Hw | ->]; [| apply tfree_trm_call_r].
    destruct (proj1 tfree_opened_mutual t 1 wObj w Hw)
      as [Hw' | ->]; [| apply tfree_trm_call_l].
    exfalso. eapply heap_method_free; eassumption.
  - exact (@carry_config_names F U
       (trm_call (avar_f wObj) m (avar_f wArg) ; s ; S ; e ; Lv)
       (open_met wArg wObj t ; s ; S ; e ;
        fv_config (trm_call (avar_f wObj) m (avar_f wArg) ; s ; S ; e ; Lv))
       eq_refl H11).
  - exact (@carry_config_null
       (trm_call (avar_f wObj) m (avar_f wArg) ; s ; S ; e ; Lv)
       (open_met wArg wObj t ; s ; S ; e ;
        fv_config (trm_call (avar_f wObj) m (avar_f wArg) ; s ; S ; e ; Lv))
       eq_refl H13).
  - inversion H15; subst. constructor; [|assumption|assumption].
    eapply method_body_closed_after_opening.
    eapply closed_definitions_member; [| exact Hmethod].
    intros n z.
    pose proof (bound_heap_item_closed ltac:(assumption) Hbind n z) as Hopen.
    change (item_obj (open_rec n z ds) = item_obj ds) in Hopen.
    now injection Hopen.
Qed.

Local Lemma visibility_in_context_domain G x :
    ctx_vis G x -> x \in ctx_dom G.
Proof.
  intros H. induction H; simpl ctx_dom; rewrite in_union.
  - left. now rewrite in_singleton.
  - now right.
Qed.

Local Lemma rename_context_identity_on_scope f G e :
    names_agree_on (ctx_dom G \u ctx_fv G) f (fun p => p) ->
    renamed_context f G G e.
Proof.
  intros Hagree. split.
  - intros x T Hb.
    assert (Hx : f x = x).
    { apply (names_agree_left Hagree). eapply context_binding_in_domain; eassumption. }
    rewrite Hx, rename_typ_inactive.
    + now apply ty_var_var.
    + intros y Hy. apply (names_agree_right Hagree).
      eapply bound_type_free_in_context; eassumption.
  - intros x Hvis.
    assert (Hx : f x = x).
    { apply (names_agree_left Hagree). now apply visibility_in_context_domain. }
    now rewrite Hx.
Qed.

Local Lemma renamed_context_hide_source f G G' e :
    renamed_context f G G' e ->
    renamed_context f (ctx_hide G) G' e.
Proof.
  intros [Hbind Hvis]. split.
  - intros x T Hb. inversion Hb; subst. now apply Hbind.
  - intros x Hv. inversion Hv.
Qed.

Local Lemma renamed_context_discharge f G G' e z k T :
    renamed_context f G G' e ->
    G' ⁏ e ⊢ f z ∶ rename_typ f T ->
    ctx_vis G' (f z) ->
    renamed_context f (G § z / k ~ T) G' e.
Proof.
  intros [Hbind Hvis] Hty Hvisible. split.
  - intros x U Hb. inversion Hb; subst; auto.
  - intros x Hv. inversion Hv; subst; auto.
Qed.

Local Lemma fresh_two_name_substitution e L x y :
    exists z c (f : var -> var),
      z \notin L /\ c \notin L /\ c <> z /\
      f z = x /\ f c = y /\
      renaming_fixes_outside (\{z} \u \{c}) f /\
      names_agree_on L f (fun p => p) /\
      renaming_respects_aliases f e e.
Proof.
  destruct (var_fresh (L \u fv_renv e)) as [z Hz].
  apply notin_union in Hz as [HzL HzEnv].
  destruct (var_fresh (L \u (fv_renv e \u \{z}))) as [c Hc].
  apply notin_union in Hc as [HcL Hc].
  apply notin_union in Hc as [HcEnv Hc].
  rewrite notin_singleton in Hc.
  set (g := replace_name (fun p => p) z x).
  exists z, c, (replace_name g c y).
  repeat split; try assumption.
  - rewrite replace_name_away by congruence. apply replace_name_at.
  - apply replace_name_at.
  - intros p Hp. rewrite notin_union, !notin_singleton in Hp. destruct Hp as [Hpz Hpc].
    unfold g. now rewrite !replace_name_away by assumption.
  - eapply names_agree_trans with (g := g).
    + now apply replace_name_fresh.
    + now apply replace_name_fresh.
  - apply replace_name_respects_aliases; [exact HcEnv |].
    apply replace_name_respects_aliases; [exact HzEnv |].
    intros a b Hb. now apply tyq_var_binds.
Qed.

Local Definition starts_with_let_or_write C :=
  match C with
  | (trm_let _ _ ; _ ; _ ; _ ; _)
  | (trm_write _ _ _ ; _ ; _ ; _ ; _) => True
  | _ => False
  end.

Local Lemma let_push_or_write_preserves F C D T :
    ty_config F C T ->
    C ↦ D ->
    starts_with_let_or_write C ->
    ty_config F D T /\ (forall y, F ⊢ D mreach y -> F ⊢ C mreach y).
Proof.
  intros Hty Hstep. destruct Hstep; simpl; intros Hguard; try contradiction.
  - eapply write_step_typing_and_reachability; eassumption.
  - split.
    + now apply let_push_preservation.
    + intros y Hy. eapply reachability_let_push; exact Hy.
Qed.

Local Lemma let_push_write_trace_preservation F C D n T :
    ty_config F C T ->
    C ⊣ n ↦* D ->
    (forall k A B, C ⊣ k ↦* A -> A ↦ B -> k < n -> starts_with_let_or_write A) ->
    ty_config F D T /\ (forall y, F ⊢ D mreach y -> F ⊢ C mreach y).
Proof.
  intros Hty Hsteps.
  induction Hsteps as [C | C A B k Hprefix IH Hstep]; intros Hall.
  - auto.
  - assert (Hprev : ty_config F A T /\ (forall y, F ⊢ A mreach y -> F ⊢ C mreach y)).
    { apply IH; [exact Hty |].
      intros j M N Hj Hstep' Hlt.
      eapply Hall; [exact Hj | exact Hstep' | now apply Nat.lt_lt_succ_r]. }
    destruct Hprev as [HtyA Hreach].
    destruct (let_push_or_write_preserves HtyA Hstep
                (Hall k A B Hprefix Hstep (Nat.lt_succ_diag_r k))) as [HtyB Hreach'].
    split; [exact HtyB |].
    intros y Hy. apply Hreach, Hreach'. exact Hy.
Qed.

Local Lemma immutability_after_let_pushes_and_writes F C D n T y ds :
    binds y (item_obj ds) (config_heap C) ->
    ty_config F C T ->
    C ⊣ n ↦* D ->
    (forall k A B, C ⊣ k ↦* A -> A ↦ B ->
      Datatypes.S k < n -> starts_with_let_or_write A) ->
    binds y (item_obj ds) (config_heap D) \/ F ⊢ C mreach y.
Proof.
  intros Hbind Hty Hsteps Hall.
  eapply immutability_from_typed_prefixes; [exact Hbind | exact Hsteps |].
  intros k A Hpath Hlt.
  assert (Hprefix : forall j M N,
    C ⊣ j ↦* M -> M ↦ N -> j < k -> starts_with_let_or_write M).
  { intros j M N Hpath' Hstep Hjk.
    eapply Hall; [exact Hpath' | exact Hstep |].
    eapply Nat.le_lt_trans; [exact Hjk | exact Hlt]. }
  destruct (let_push_write_trace_preservation Hty Hpath Hprefix) as [HtyA Hreach].
  exists F, T. split; [exact HtyA | apply Hreach].
Qed.

Theorem immutability_guarantee t1 s1 S1 e1 Lv1 F T n t2 s2 S2 e2 Lv2 y ds:
    binds y (item_obj ds) S1 ->
    ty_config F (t1 ; s1 ; S1 ; e1; Lv1) T ->
    (t1 ; s1 ; S1 ; e1; Lv1) ⊣ n ↦* (t2 ; s2 ; S2 ; e2; Lv2) -> (
      binds y (item_obj ds) S2 \/
      F ⊢ (t1 ; s1 ; S1 ; e1; Lv1) mreach y
    ).

End WithRodotMode.

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra.

Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.

Inductive mode :=
  | basic
  | basic_no_fun
  | basic_incap
  | basic_sef_typing
  | rodot
  | rodot_top_nm
  | rodot_nm_compl
  | rodot_nm_muttop
  | rodot_nm_compl_muttop
  | rodot_sef.

Class Mode := mode_m: mode.

Definition mode_has_fun' m: bool := match m with
| basic | basic_sef_typing => true
| _ => false
end.

Notation mode_has_fun m := ((mode_has_fun' m) = true)(only parsing).

Definition mode_has_mutability' m: bool := match m with
| rodot | rodot_top_nm | rodot_nm_compl | rodot_nm_muttop | rodot_nm_compl_muttop | rodot_sef => true
| _ => false

  ctx_kdom v_ref G = dom e /\
  renv_corr G e /\

Inductive ty_var : Typing var :=

| ty_var_var : forall G e x T,
    ctx_binds x T G ->
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ T

| ty_rec_intro : forall G e x T,
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ open x T ->
    typ_indep_b 0 T ->

    ((mode_has_incap typing_mode) -> (G⁏e ⊢ (open x T) ∶icp (open x T))) ->
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ typ_bnd T

| ty_rec_elim : forall G e x T,
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ typ_bnd T ->
    typ_indep_b 0 T ->
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ open x T

| ty_var_and : forall G e x T U,
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ T ->
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ U ->
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ typ_and T U

| ty_var_sub : forall G e x T U,
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ T ->
    G⁏e ⊢ T <: U ->
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ U

| ty_var_mut_top : forall G e x T,
    mode_has_mutability typing_mode ->
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ T ->
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ (typ_mut_marker typ_top)

with subtyp : Subtyping :=

| subtyp_top: forall G e T,
    G⁏e ⊢ T <: typ_top

| subtyp_bot: forall G e T,
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_bot <: T

| subtyp_refl: forall G e T,
    G⁏e ⊢ T <: T

| subtyp_trans: forall G e S T U,
    G⁏e ⊢ S <: T ->
    G⁏e ⊢ T <: U ->
    G⁏e ⊢ S <: U

| subtyp_and11: forall G e T U,
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_and T U <: T

| subtyp_and12: forall G e T U,
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_and T U <: U

| subtyp_and2: forall G e S T U,
    G⁏e ⊢ S <: T ->
    G⁏e ⊢ S <: U ->
    G⁏e ⊢ S <: typ_and T U

| subtyp_or11: forall G e T U,
    G⁏e ⊢ T <: typ_or T U

| subtyp_or12: forall G e T U,
    G⁏e ⊢ U <: typ_or T U

| subtyp_or2: forall G e S T U,
    G⁏e ⊢ S <: T ->
    G⁏e ⊢ U <: T ->
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_or S U <: T

| subtyp_fld: forall G e a T1 T2 U1 U2,
    G⁏e ⊢ T1 <: T2 ->
    G⁏e ⊢ U1 <: U2 ->
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_rcd (dec_fld a T2 U1) <: typ_rcd (dec_fld a T1 U2)

| subtyp_typ: forall G e A S1 T1 S2 T2,
    (forall x, G⁏e ⊢ (open x S2) <: (open x S1)) ->
    (forall x, G⁏e ⊢ (open x T1) <: (open x T2)) ->
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_rcd (dec_typ A S1 T1) <: typ_rcd (dec_typ A S2 T2)

| subtyp_sel2: forall G e x A y S T,
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ typ_rcd (dec_typ A S T) ->

| subtyp_sel1: forall G e x A y S T,
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ typ_rcd (dec_typ A S T) ->

| subtyp_fun: forall L G e S1 T1 S2 T2,
    mode_has_fun typing_mode ->
    G⁏e ⊢ S2 <: S1 ->
    (forall x, x \notin L ->
       G § x / v_par ~ S2 ⁏e ⊢ open x T1 <: open x T2) ->
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_fun S1 T1 <: typ_fun S2 T2

| subtyp_met: forall L G e m TC1 TZ1 TR1 TC2 TZ2 TR2,
    G⁏e ⊢ TZ2 <: TZ1 ->
    (forall x, x \notin L ->
    G § x / v_par ~ TZ2 ⁏e ⊢ open x TC2 <: open x TC1) ->

    (mode_has_sef typing_mode -> typ_indep_b 0 TC2 -> typ_indep_b 0 TC1) ->
    (forall x, x \notin L ->
     forall y, y <> x -> y \notin L ->
    (ctx_met G x TZ2 y TC2) ⁏e ⊢ open_met x y TR1 <: open_met x y TR2) ->

| subtyp_tyq: forall G e T1 T2,

| subtyp_typ_and: forall G e A S1 T1 S2 T2,

     <: typ_rcd (dec_typ A (typ_or S1 S2) (typ_and T1 T2))

| subtyp_dist: forall G e T1 T2 T3,
    G⁏e ⊢
      typ_and T1 (typ_or T2 T3)

| subtyp_nocap_bnd G e T:
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_nocap <: typ_bnd T

| subtyp_nocap_typ G e A T1 T2:
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_nocap <: typ_rcd (dec_typ (typ_label_normal A) T1 T2)

| subtyp_nocap_fld G e a T1 T2:
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_nocap <: typ_rcd (dec_fld a T1 T2)

| subtyp_nocap_met G e a TC TZ TR:
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_nocap <: typ_rcd (dec_met a TC TZ TR)

| subtyp_nocap_fun G e TZ TR:

| subtyp_nocap_mut_top_boundless G e T1 T2:

| subtyp_nocap_mut_top_complement G e:

| subtyp_nocap_mut_bot G e:

    G⁏e ⊢ (typ_and typ_nocap (typ_mut_marker typ_bot)) <: typ_bot

| subtyp_mut_top G e:

    G⁏e ⊢ typ_top <: (typ_mut_marker typ_top)

| ty_incap_top G e:
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_top ∶icp typ_top

| ty_incap_bot G e:
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_bot ∶icp typ_nocap

| ty_incap_typ G e A S T:
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_rcd (dec_typ (typ_label_normal A) S T)

| ty_incap_cap G e M S T:
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_rcd (dec_typ (typ_label_refcap M) S T)

| ty_incap_met G e m TC TZ TR:
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_rcd (dec_met m TC TZ TR) ∶icp typ_rcd (dec_met m TC TZ TR)

| ty_incap_fld G e a T1 T2:
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_rcd (dec_fld a T1 T2) ∶icp typ_rcd (dec_fld a T1 T2)

| ty_incap_sel G e x B y S T T':

Local Definition method_type_bounds F e C Z R C' Z' R' : Prop :=
  F ⁏ e ⊢ Z' <: Z /\
  exists L,
    (forall x, x \notin L -> F § x / v_par ~ Z' ⁏ e ⊢ open x C' <: open x C) /\
    (forall x, x \notin L -> forall y, y <> x -> y \notin L ->

Local Lemma method_type_bounds_refl F e C Z R :
    method_type_bounds F e C Z R C Z R.
Proof.
  split; [apply subtyp_refl |].
  exists (\{} : vars). split; intros; apply subtyp_refl.
Qed.

Local Lemma method_type_bounds_trans F e C0 Z0 R0 C1 Z1 R1 C2 Z2 R2 :
    method_type_bounds F e C0 Z0 R0 C1 Z1 R1 ->
    method_type_bounds F e C1 Z1 R1 C2 Z2 R2 ->
    method_type_bounds F e C0 Z0 R0 C2 Z2 R2.
Proof.
  intros (HZ01 & L1 & HC01 & HR01) (HZ12 & L2 & HC12 & HR12).
  split; [eapply subtyp_trans; eassumption |].
  exists (L1 \u (L2 \u ctx_dom F)). split.
  - intros x Hx. rewrite !notin_union in Hx.
    destruct Hx as [Hx1 [Hx2 HxF]].
    eapply subtyp_trans; [exact (HC12 x Hx2) |].
    eapply replace_subtyping; [| exact (HC01 x Hx1)].
    exact (proj1 (@narrow_last_binding F e x v_par Z2 Z1 HxF HZ12)).
  - intros x Hx y Hneq Hy.
    rewrite !notin_union in Hx, Hy.
    destruct Hx as [Hx1 [Hx2 HxF]], Hy as [Hy1 [Hy2 HyF]].
    assert (Hfresh2 : y §# (F § x / v_par ~ Z2)) by now apply fresh_pushed_context.
    pose proof (@narrow_last_binding F e x v_par Z2 Z1 HxF HZ12) as Hpar.
    pose proof (@typing_context_extends_push _ _ e y v_recv (open x C1)
                 Hfresh2 Hpar) as Hmethod.
    pose proof (@narrow_last_binding (F § x / v_par ~ Z2) e y v_recv
                  (open x C2) (open x C1) Hfresh2 (HC12 x Hx2)) as Hrecv.
    eapply subtyp_trans; [| exact (HR12 x Hx2 y Hneq Hy2)].
    eapply replace_subtyping; [exact (proj1 Hrecv) |].
    eapply replace_subtyping; [exact (proj1 Hmethod) | exact (HR01 x Hx1 y Hneq Hy1)].
Qed.
