      (exists G', ty_config G' B T /\
        (G' ⊢ B mreach y -> G ⊢ A mreach y))) ->
    binds y (item_obj ds) (config_heap C) ->
    ty_config F C U ->
    C ⊣ n ↦* D ->
    binds y (item_obj ds) (config_heap D) \/ F ⊢ C mreach y.
Proof.
  intros Hfresh Hbind Hty Htrace.
  eapply immutability_from_typed_prefixes; [exact Hbind | exact Htrace |].
  intros k A Hpath _. clear Htrace Hbind.
  induction Hpath as [A | A B E j Hpath IH Hstep].
  - exists F, U. auto.
  - destruct (IH Hty) as (G & T & HtyB & Hr).
    destruct (classic (step_uses_same_context B)) as [Hsame | Hcreates].
    + destruct (same_context_step_preservation HtyB Hstep Hsame) as [HtyE Hreach].
      exists G, T. split; [exact HtyE | auto].
    + destruct (Hfresh G B E T HtyB Hstep Hcreates) as (G' & HtyE & Hreach).
      exists G', T. split; [exact HtyE | auto].
Qed.

Local Lemma same_context_trace_preservation F C D n T :
    ty_config F C T ->
    C ⊣ n ↦* D ->
    (forall k A B, C ⊣ k ↦* A -> A ↦ B -> k < n -> step_uses_same_context A) ->
    ty_config F D T /\ (forall y, F ⊢ D mreach y -> F ⊢ C mreach y).
Proof.
  intros Hty Hsteps.
  induction Hsteps as [C | C A B k Hprefix IH Hstep]; intros Hall.
  - auto.
  - assert (Hprev : ty_config F A T /\ (forall y, F ⊢ A mreach y -> F ⊢ C mreach y)).
    { apply IH; [exact Hty |].
      intros j M N Hj Hstep' Hlt.
      eapply Hall; [exact Hj | exact Hstep' | now apply Nat.lt_lt_succ_r]. }
    destruct Hprev as [HtyA Hreach].
    destruct (same_context_step_preservation HtyA Hstep
                (Hall k A B Hprefix Hstep (Nat.lt_succ_diag_r k))) as [HtyB Hreach'].
    split; [exact HtyB |].
    intros y Hy. apply Hreach, Hreach'. exact Hy.
Qed.

Local Lemma immutability_after_same_context_steps F C D n T y ds :
    binds y (item_obj ds) (config_heap C) ->
    ty_config F C T ->
    C ⊣ n ↦* D ->
    (forall k A B, C ⊣ k ↦* A -> A ↦ B ->
      Datatypes.S k < n -> step_uses_same_context A) ->
    binds y (item_obj ds) (config_heap D) \/ F ⊢ C mreach y.
Proof.
  intros Hbind Hty Hsteps Hall.
  eapply immutability_from_typed_prefixes; [exact Hbind | exact Hsteps |].
  intros k A Hpath Hlt.
  assert (Hprefix : forall j M N,
    C ⊣ j ↦* M -> M ↦ N -> j < k -> step_uses_same_context M).
  { intros j M N Hpath' Hstep Hjk.
    eapply Hall; [exact Hpath' | exact Hstep |].
    eapply Nat.le_lt_trans; [exact Hjk | exact Hlt]. }
  destruct (same_context_trace_preservation Hty Hpath Hprefix) as [HtyA Hreach].
  exists F, T. split; [exact HtyA | apply Hreach].
Qed.

Theorem immutability_guarantee t1 s1 S1 e1 Lv1 F T n t2 s2 S2 e2 Lv2 y ds:
    binds y (item_obj ds) S1 ->
    ty_config F (t1 ; s1 ; S1 ; e1; Lv1) T ->
    (t1 ; s1 ; S1 ; e1; Lv1) ⊣ n ↦* (t2 ; s2 ; S2 ; e2; Lv2) -> (
      binds y (item_obj ds) S2 \/
      F ⊢ (t1 ; s1 ; S1 ; e1; Lv1) mreach y
    ).

    + apply ctx_vis_e.
    + apply ctx_vis_n; auto.

  - intros x T Hhidden. inversion Hhidden; subst.
    assert (Hty : G' ⁏ e ⊢ x ∶ T) by (eapply Hbind; eassumption).

Inductive typ : Set :=
  | typ_top  : typ
  | typ_bot  : typ
  | typ_rcd  : dec -> typ
  | typ_and  : typ -> typ -> typ
  | typ_or   : typ -> typ -> typ
  | typ_sel  : avar -> typ_label -> avar -> typ
  | typ_bnd  : typ -> typ
  | typ_fun  : typ -> typ -> typ
  | typ_nocap: typ

with dec : Set :=
  | dec_typ: typ_label -> typ -> typ -> dec
  | dec_fld: fld_label -> typ -> typ -> dec
  | dec_met: met_label ->  typ -> typ -> typ -> dec
.

Notation typ_cap_marker C T := (typ_rcd (dec_typ (typ_label_refcap C) typ_bot T)) (only parsing).

Notation typ_mut_marker T := (typ_cap_marker typ_refcap_mutability T) (only parsing).

Fixpoint open_rec_typ (k: nat) (u: var) (T: typ) {struct T} : typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_top        => typ_top
  | typ_bot        => typ_bot
  | typ_rcd D      => typ_rcd (open_rec_dec k u D)
  | typ_and T1 T2  => typ_and (open_rec_typ k u T1)
                             (open_rec_typ k u T2)
  | typ_or T1 T2  => typ_or (open_rec_typ k u T1)
                             (open_rec_typ k u T2)
  | typ_sel x L y => typ_sel (open_rec k u x) L (open_rec k u y)
  | typ_bnd T      => typ_bnd (open_rec_typ (S k) u T)
  | typ_fun T1 T2  => typ_fun (open_rec_typ k u T1)
                             (open_rec_typ (S k) u T2)
  | typ_nocap => typ_nocap
  end with
open_rec_dec (k: nat) (u: var) (D: dec): dec :=
  match D with
  | dec_typ L T U => dec_typ L (open_rec_typ (S k) u T)
                            (open_rec_typ (S k) u U)
  | dec_fld m T U => dec_fld m (open_rec_typ k u T)
                            (open_rec_typ k u U)
  | dec_met m TC TZ TR =>
    dec_met m (open_rec_typ (S k) u TC) (open_rec_typ k u TZ) (open_rec_typ (S (S k)) u TR)
  end.

Instance TypOpenable : Openable typ := open_rec_typ.

Instance DecOpenable : Openable dec := open_rec_dec.

Fixpoint fv_typ (T: typ) : vars :=
  match T with
  | typ_top        => \{}
  | typ_bot        => \{}
  | typ_rcd D      => (fv_dec D)
  | typ_and T U    => (fv_typ T) \u (fv_typ U)
  | typ_or T U    => (fv_typ T) \u (fv_typ U)
  | typ_sel x L y   => (fv x) \u (fv y)
  | typ_bnd T      => (fv_typ T)
  | typ_fun T1 T2  => (fv_typ T1) \u (fv_typ T2)
  | typ_nocap => \{}
  end with
fv_dec (D: dec) : vars :=
  match D with
  | dec_typ L T U => (fv_typ T) \u (fv_typ U)
  | dec_fld m T U => (fv_typ T) \u (fv_typ U)
  | dec_met m TC TZ TR => (fv_typ TC) \u (fv_typ TZ) \u (fv_typ TR)
  end.

Instance TypFreeVar : FreeVar typ := fv_typ.

Instance DecFreeVar : FreeVar dec := fv_dec.

Fixpoint subst_typ (z: var) (u: var) (T: typ) { struct T } : typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_top        => typ_top
  | typ_bot        => typ_bot
  | typ_rcd D      => typ_rcd (subst_dec z u D)
  | typ_and T1 T2  => typ_and (subst_typ z u T1) (subst_typ z u T2)
  | typ_or T1 T2  => typ_or (subst_typ z u T1) (subst_typ z u T2)
  | typ_sel x L y    => typ_sel (subst_var z u x) L (subst_var z u y)
  | typ_bnd T      => typ_bnd (subst_typ z u T)
  | typ_fun T U    => typ_fun (subst_typ z u T) (subst_typ z u U)
  | typ_nocap => typ_nocap
  end with
subst_dec (z: var) (u: var) (D: dec) { struct D } : dec :=
  match D with
  | dec_typ L T U => dec_typ L (subst_typ z u T) (subst_typ z u U)
  | dec_fld L T U => dec_fld L (subst_typ z u T) (subst_typ z u U)
  | dec_met m TC TZ TR => dec_met m (subst_typ z u TC) (subst_typ z u TZ) (subst_typ z u TR)
  end.

Instance TypSubstVar : SubstVar typ := subst_typ.

Instance DecSubstVar : SubstVar dec := subst_dec.

Fixpoint seal_rec_typ (k: nat) (u: var) (T: typ) {struct T} : typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_top        => typ_top
  | typ_bot        => typ_bot
  | typ_rcd D      => typ_rcd (seal_rec_dec k u D)
  | typ_and T1 T2  => typ_and (seal_rec_typ k u T1)
                             (seal_rec_typ k u T2)
  | typ_or T1 T2  => typ_or (seal_rec_typ k u T1)
                             (seal_rec_typ k u T2)
  | typ_sel x L y => typ_sel (seal_rec k u x) L (seal_rec k u y)
  | typ_bnd T      => typ_bnd (seal_rec_typ (S k) u T)
  | typ_fun T1 T2  => typ_fun (seal_rec_typ k u T1)
                             (seal_rec_typ (S k) u T2)
  | typ_nocap => typ_nocap
  end with
seal_rec_dec (k: nat) (u: var) (D: dec): dec :=
  match D with
  | dec_typ L T U => dec_typ L (seal_rec_typ (S k) u T)
                            (seal_rec_typ (S k) u U)
  | dec_fld m T U => dec_fld m (seal_rec_typ k u T)
                            (seal_rec_typ k u U)
  | dec_met m TC TZ TR =>
    dec_met m (seal_rec_typ (S k) u TC) (seal_rec_typ k u TZ) (seal_rec_typ (S (S k)) u TR)
  end.

Instance TypSealable : Sealable typ := seal_rec_typ.

Instance DecSealable : Sealable dec := seal_rec_dec.

Instance DecLabelOf : LabelOf dec :=
  fun D =>

      | dec_fld m _ _ => label_fld m

Fixpoint collect_typ {C: Type} (df : C) (f : avar -> C) (comb: C -> C -> C) (T: typ) : C :=
  match T with
  | typ_top        => df
  | typ_bot        => df
  | typ_rcd D      => (collect_dec df f comb D)
  | typ_and T U    => comb (collect_typ df f comb T) (collect_typ df f comb U)
  | typ_or T U    => comb (collect_typ df f comb T) (collect_typ df f comb U)
  | typ_sel x L y    => comb (f x) (f y)

Local Lemma typed_method_free G Go e m t D w :
    G §§ Go ⁏ e ⊢ def_met m t ∶d D ->

Proof.

  | Hbody : forall z, z \notin ?L -> forall c, c <> z ->

Local Lemma typed_defs_member_record G Go e ds T :
    G §§ Go ⁏ e ⊢ ds ∶ T ->
    forall d, defs_has ds d ->
    exists D, record_has T D /\ G §§ Go ⁏ e ⊢ d ∶d D.
Proof.
  intros Hty. induction Hty; intros member Hhas.
  - unfold defs_has in Hhas. simpl get_def in Hhas.
    destruct (classic (label_of d = label_of member)) as [Heq | Hneq].
    + rewrite If_l in Hhas by exact Heq. inversion Hhas; subst.
      eexists. split; [apply rh_one | eassumption].
    + rewrite If_r in Hhas by exact Hneq. discriminate.
  - unfold defs_has in Hhas. simpl get_def in Hhas.
    destruct (classic (label_of d = label_of member)) as [Heq | Hneq].
    + rewrite If_l in Hhas by exact Heq. inversion Hhas; subst.
      eexists. split; [apply rh_andr, rh_one | eassumption].
    + rewrite If_r in Hhas by exact Hneq.
      destruct (IHHty member Hhas) as [D' [Hmember Hty']].
      exists D'. split; [now apply rh_andl | exact Hty'].
Qed.

Local Lemma typed_defs_member G Go e ds T :

Local Lemma heap_reference_extension F e S w y R B G :
    heap_correspond F e S ->
    ctx_binds_k_after y v_loc (typ_objref R (typ_mut_marker typ_bot)) F G ->
    w §# F ->
    w # e ->
    heap_correspond (F § w / v_ref ~ typ_objref R (typ_mut_marker B)) (e & w ~ y) S.

    Hbound Hfresh HfreshEnv.
  set (A := typ_objref R (typ_mut_marker B)).
  set (F' := F § w / v_ref ~ A).
  assert (He : env_binds_more e (e & w ~ y)).
  { intros b a Hb. apply binds_push_neq; [exact Hb |].
    intros ->. exact (binds_fresh_inv Hb HfreshEnv). }
  assert (HF : typing_context_extends F F' (e & w ~ y)).
  { unfold F'. now apply extend_context_typing. }
  split; [constructor; assumption |].
  split; [constructor; assumption |].
  split; [exact Hheap |].
  split; [now apply ok_push |].
  split.
  { simpl ctx_kdom. rewrite If_r by discriminate. exact Hloc. }
  split.
  { simpl ctx_kdom. rewrite If_l by reflexivity. now rewrite Href, dom_push. }
  split.
  { eapply renv_corr_ref with (G2 := F) (G3 := G)
      (Tw := A) (Ty := typ_objref R (typ_mut_marker typ_bot)).
    - apply ctx_binds_k_e.
    - exact Hbound.

    - now apply renv_correspondence_extend_scope. }
  intros x Hx. specialize (Hitem x Hx). inversion Hitem; subst.
  - pose proof mode_disallows_functions. congruence.
  - eapply ty_item_obj_s; [| eassumption | reflexivity | |].
    + unfold F'. eapply fresh_context_extension; eassumption.
    + pose proof (identity_renaming_of_contexts HF) as Hrename.
      match goal with Hd : F §§ objctx_heap x ?U ⁏ e ⊢ ?ds ∶ open x ?U |- _ =>
        pose proof (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 term_typing_renaming))
          F (objctx_heap x U) e ds _ Hd (fun v => v) \{} F' (e & w ~ y)
          (fun _ _ => eq_refl) (extends_reference_environment He) Hrename Hrename)
          as Hdefs
      end.
      cbn [rename_objctx] in Hdefs.
      now rewrite (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 rename_terms_identity))),
        !(proj1 rename_types_identity) in Hdefs.
    + unfold F'. now apply definitions_keep_kinds.

Class TFree(A : Set) := tfree: var -> A -> Prop.

Inductive tfree_trm: TFree trm :=

| tfree_trm_var v:
  tfree_trm v (trm_var (avar_f v))

| tfree_trm_read v1 l:
  tfree_trm v1 (trm_read (avar_f v1) l)

| tfree_trm_apply_l v1 a2:
  tfree_trm v1 (trm_apply (avar_f v1) a2)
| tfree_trm_apply_r a1 v2:
  tfree_trm v2 (trm_apply a1 (avar_f v2))

| tfree_trm_let_l v t1 t2:
  tfree_trm v t1 ->
  tfree_trm v (trm_let t1 t2)
| tfree_trm_let_r v t1 t2:
  tfree_trm v t2 ->
  tfree_trm v (trm_let t1 t2)

| tfree_trm_lit_l v t1 t2:
  tfree_lit v t1 ->
  tfree_trm v (trm_lit t1 t2)
| tfree_trm_lit_r v t1 t2:
  tfree_trm v t2 ->
  tfree_trm v (trm_lit t1 t2)

| tfree_trm_write_l v1 a2 l:
  tfree_trm v1 (trm_write (avar_f v1) l a2)
| tfree_trm_write_r a1 v2 l:
  tfree_trm v2 (trm_write a1 l (avar_f v2))

| tfree_trm_call_l v1 a2 l:
  tfree_trm v1 (trm_call (avar_f v1) l a2)
| tfree_trm_call_r a1 v2 l:
  tfree_trm v2 (trm_call a1 l (avar_f v2))

with tfree_lit: TFree lit :=

| tfree_lit_fun v t T:
  tfree_trm v t ->
  tfree_lit v (lit_fun T t)
| tfree_lit_obj v t T:
  tfree_defs v t ->
  tfree_lit v (lit_obj T t)

with tfree_def: TFree def :=

| tfree_def_trm v l:
  tfree_def v (def_fld l (avar_f v))

| tfree_def_met v t l:
  tfree_trm v t ->
  tfree_def v (def_met l t)

with tfree_defs: TFree defs :=

| tfree_defs_cons_l v d ds:
  tfree_defs v ds ->
  tfree_defs v (defs_cons ds d)
| tfree_defs_cons_r v d ds:
  tfree_def v d ->
  tfree_defs v (defs_cons ds d)

  tfree_stack v st ->

Local Definition equivalent_declaration_parts e (d d' : dec) : Prop :=
  match d, d' with
  | dec_fld a L U, dec_fld a' L' U' =>
      a = a' /\ e ⊢ L ≈ L' /\ e ⊢ U ≈ U'
  | dec_typ a L U, dec_typ a' L' U' =>
      a = a' /\ (forall z, e ⊢ open z L ≈ open z L') /\
                (forall z, e ⊢ open z U ≈ open z U')
  | dec_met a C Z R, dec_met a' C' Z' R' =>
      a = a' /\ (forall x, e ⊢ open x C ≈ open x C') /\
      e ⊢ Z ≈ Z' /\ (forall x y, e ⊢ open_met x y R ≈ open_met x y R')
  | _, _ => False
  end.

Local Definition equivalent_type_parts e (T U : typ) : Prop :=
  match T, U with
  | typ_top, typ_top | typ_bot, typ_bot | typ_nocap, typ_nocap => True
  | typ_and a b, typ_and c d | typ_or a b, typ_or c d =>
      e ⊢ a ≈ c /\ e ⊢ b ≈ d
  | typ_bnd a, typ_bnd b => forall z, e ⊢ open z a ≈ open z b
  | typ_rcd a, typ_rcd b => equivalent_declaration_parts e a b
  | typ_fun a b, typ_fun c d =>
      e ⊢ a ≈ c /\ (forall z, e ⊢ open z b ≈ open z d)
  | typ_sel a l b, typ_sel c l' d =>
      l = l' /\ b = d /\
      (a = c \/ exists x y k,
        a = avar_f x /\ c = avar_f y /\ l = typ_label_normal k /\ e ⊢ x ≈ y)
  | _, _ => False
  end.

Local Lemma rename_equivalence_under_open e (T U : typ) n :
    (forall z f e', renaming_respects_aliases f e e' ->
        e' ⊢ rename_typ f (open_rec n z T) ≈ rename_typ f (open_rec n z U)) ->
    forall x f e', renaming_respects_aliases f e e' ->
        e' ⊢ open_rec n x (rename_typ f T) ≈ open_rec n x (rename_typ f U).
Proof.
  intros H x f e' Henv.
  destruct (renaming_can_open_at (fv T \u fv U) x Henv)
    as [z [g [Hmap [Hagree Henv']]]].
  pose proof (H z g e' Henv') as Heq.
  rewrite !(proj1 rename_type_open) in Heq.
  rewrite Hmap in Heq.
  rewrite (proj1 rename_types_congruent T g f 0 (names_agree_left Hagree)) in Heq.
  rewrite (proj1 rename_types_congruent U g f 0 (names_agree_right Hagree)) in Heq.
  exact Heq.
Qed.

Local Lemma rename_equivalence_under_two_opens e (T U : typ) :
    (forall z w f e', renaming_respects_aliases f e e' ->
        e' ⊢ rename_typ f (open_met z w T) ≈ rename_typ f (open_met z w U)) ->
    forall x y f e', renaming_respects_aliases f e e' ->
        e' ⊢ open_met x y (rename_typ f T) ≈ open_met x y (rename_typ f U).
Proof.
  intros H x y f e' Henv.
  destruct (renaming_can_open_at (fv T \u fv U) y Henv)
    as [w [g [Hy [Hagree Henv']]]].
  destruct (renaming_can_open_at ((fv T \u fv U) \u \{w}) x Henv')
    as [z [h [Hx [Hagree' Henv'']]]].
  assert (Hw : h w = y).
  { rewrite <- Hy. apply (names_agree_right Hagree').
    now rewrite in_singleton. }
  pose proof (H z w h e' Henv'') as Heq.
  rewrite !(proj1 rename_type_open), Hx, Hw in Heq.
  pose proof (names_agree_trans (names_agree_left Hagree') Hagree) as Hsame.
  rewrite (proj1 rename_types_congruent T h f 0 (names_agree_left Hsame)) in Heq.
  rewrite (proj1 rename_types_congruent U h f 0 (names_agree_right Hsame)) in Heq.
  exact Heq.
Qed.

Local Lemma rename_equivalence e (T U : typ) :
    e ⊢ T ≈ U ->
    forall f e', renaming_respects_aliases f e e' ->
    e' ⊢ rename_typ f T ≈ rename_typ f U.

Instance DecCollect : Collect AvarAbstractSyntax DecAbstractSyntax :=

Fixpoint transform_typ (f : avar -> nat -> avar) (T : typ) (n : nat) : typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_top        => typ_top
  | typ_bot        => typ_bot
  | typ_rcd D      => typ_rcd (transform_dec f D n)
  | typ_and T1 T2  => typ_and (transform_typ f T1 n) (transform_typ f T2 n)
  | typ_or T1 T2  => typ_or (transform_typ f T1 n) (transform_typ f T2 n)
  | typ_sel x L y    => typ_sel (f x n) L (f y n)
  | typ_bnd T      => typ_bnd (transform_typ f T (S n))
  | typ_fun T1 T2  => typ_fun (transform_typ f T1 n) (transform_typ f T2 (S n))
  | typ_nocap => typ_nocap
  end with
transform_dec (f : avar -> nat -> avar) (D : dec) (n : nat) : dec :=
  match D with
  | dec_typ L T U => dec_typ L (transform_typ f T (S n)) (transform_typ f U (S n))
  | dec_fld m T U => dec_fld m (transform_typ f T n) (transform_typ f U n)
  | dec_met m TC TZ TR => dec_met m (transform_typ f TC (S n)) (transform_typ f TZ n) (transform_typ f TR (S (S n)))
  end.

Instance TypTransform : Transform AvarAbstractSyntax TypAbstractSyntax :=
  @transform_typ.

Instance DecTransform : Transform AvarAbstractSyntax DecAbstractSyntax :=

    closed U ->
    execution_config F (t ; s ; S ; e ; Lv) U.

Inductive frame : Set :=

Fixpoint stack_length (fs : stack) : nat :=
  match fs with
  | stack_nil => 0
  | stack_cons _ fs' => (stack_length fs') + 1
  end.

Definition frame_fv fr := match fr with frame_let c => fv c end.

Instance FrameFreeVar : FreeVar frame := frame_fv.

Fixpoint stack_fv s: vars :=
  match s with
  | stack_nil => \{}
  | stack_cons f fs => (fv f) \u (@fv stack stack_fv fs)
  end.

Instance StackFreeVar : FreeVar stack := stack_fv.

Definition frame_subst_var x y fr :=
  match fr with frame_let c => frame_let (subst_var x y c) end.

Instance FrameSubstVar: SubstVar frame := frame_subst_var.

Fixpoint stack_subst_var x y st :=
  match st with
    | stack_nil => stack_nil
    | stack_cons f fs => stack_cons (subst_var x y f) (@subst_var stack stack_subst_var x y fs)
  end.

Instance StackSubstVar: SubstVar stack := stack_subst_var.

Definition frame_open n x fr :=
  match fr with frame_let c => frame_let (open_rec n x c) end.

Instance FrameOpenable: Openable frame := frame_open.

Fixpoint stack_open n x st :=
  match st with
    | stack_nil => stack_nil
    | stack_cons f fs => stack_cons (open_rec (S n) x f) (@open_rec stack stack_open n x fs)
  end.

Instance StackOpenable:  Openable stack := stack_open.

Instance StackAbstractSyntax :
  AbstractSyntax StackOpenable StackFreeVar StackSubstVar := {}.

Definition collect_frame {C: Type} (df : C) (f : avar -> C) (comb: C -> C -> C) (fr: frame) : C :=
  match fr with

Instance FrameCollect : Collect AvarAbstractSyntax FrameAbstractSyntax :=

Fixpoint collect_stack {C: Type} (df : C) (f : avar -> C) (comb: C -> C -> C) (st: stack) : C :=

Instance StackCollect : Collect AvarAbstractSyntax StackAbstractSyntax :=
